' ============================================================
' READ-ONLY MIRROR — do not edit this file directly.
' Source: Silly Wizard Work.xlsm  Module: modParseABC
' Edit in the Excel workbook; copy back to update this mirror.
' Reference: EXCEL_VBA_MAP.md (Module 1)
' ============================================================
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' CONFIGURATION
' ============================================================

Const SHEET_EVENTS As String = "Tune"  ' Legacy: no longer used — ParseAllParts operates on ActiveSheet
' Parts table: G = Type, H = Voice/Instrument, I = main ABC, J = Tail Add, K = Head Add
' Row with Type="metadata" provides the ABC header block.
' All other rows are processed in order (melody first, then appended).
Const PART_TABLE_TYPE_COL  As Long = 7   ' Column G
Const PART_TABLE_VOICE_COL As Long = 8   ' Column H
Const PART_TABLE_ABC_COL   As Long = 9   ' Column I
Const PART_TABLE_TAIL_COL  As Long = 10  ' Column J (Tail Add)
Const PART_TABLE_HEAD_COL  As Long = 11  ' Column K (Head Add)
Const PART_TABLE_FIRST_ROW As Long = 2   ' Row 2 is the metadata row
Const PART_TABLE_MAX_ROW   As Long = 25  ' Scan up to this row for parts

Const EMBELLISH_LIBRARY_FIRST_ROW As Long = 2
Const EMBELLISH_LIBRARY_ID_COL As Long = 1
Const EMBELLISH_LIBRARY_PATTERN_COL As Long = 3
Const EMBELLISH_LIBRARY_TARGET_COL As Long = 4

Const HEADER_ROW As Long = 50
Const FIRST_DATA_ROW As Long = 51

' ============================================================
' COLUMN MAPPING — NEW 23-COLUMN SCHEMA
' ============================================================

Const COL_EVENT_ID As Long = 1
Const COL_TYPE As Long = 2
Const COL_STRUCTURE As Long = 3

Const COL_PART As Long = 4
Const COL_MEASURE As Long = 5
Const COL_BEAT As Long = 6
Const COL_DIVISION As Long = 7
Const COL_PHRASE As Long = 8

Const COL_NOTE_LETTER As Long = 9
Const COL_NOTE_MIDI As Long = 10

Const COL_WRITTEN_UNITS As Long = 11
Const COL_ADJUSTED_UNITS As Long = 12
Const COL_TOTAL_UNITS As Long = 13

Const COL_EMBELLISH_PRECEDING As Long = 14
Const COL_EMBELLISH_LITERAL As Long = 15
Const COL_EMBELLISH_TARGET As Long = 16
Const COL_EMBELLISH_ALT_ANCHOR As Long = 17
Const COL_EMBELLISH_ALT_TIMING As Long = 18

Const COL_BROKEN_DIR As Long = 19

Const COL_START_MS As Long = 20
Const COL_END_MS As Long = 21
Const COL_TEMPO_BPM As Long = 22
Const COL_VOICE As Long = 23

' ============================================================
' MUSICAL CONSTANTS (now dynamic via module-level variables)
' ============================================================

Private TimeSigNum As Long          ' e.g., 7 for 7/4
Private TimeSigDen As Long          ' e.g., 4 for 7/4
Private UnitNoteFraction As Double  ' e.g., 0.125 for L:1/8
Private UnitsPerBeat As Double      ' calculated: beat duration / unit duration
Private BeatsPerMeasure As Long     ' = TimeSigNum
Private UnitsPerMeasure As Double   ' = UnitsPerBeat * BeatsPerMeasure

Private PickupOffsetUnits As Double
Private PickupDetected As Boolean
Private DownbeatBarUnits() As Double
Private DownbeatBarCount As Long

' Multi-part append state (used by ParseAllParts; reset after completion)
Private AppendStartRow As Long  ' 0 = write from FIRST_DATA_ROW; >0 = append here
Private ActiveVoice As String   ' Voice label written to COL_VOICE for the current part

' Score export flag: default OFF. Set True via tune metadata key "score_merge_split_bars" = "true".
' Enables split-bar merging for tunes whose pickup/volta structure creates complementary partial bars.
Private MergeSplitBarsForScore As Boolean

' Aggregated missing-embellishment tracking (per parse/validation run).
Private MissingEmbellishmentsMap As Object

Const EPSILON As Double = 0.000001
Const ROUND_DECIMALS As Long = 9

' Score image export sizing defaults (used when worksheet metadata does not override).
' Goal: keep rendered measure widths close to the expected on-screen time viewport at default BPM.
Const SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_VIEW_AHEAD_MS As Double = 4500#
Const SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_VIEW_BEHIND_MS As Double = 2250#
Const SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_BPM As Double = 84#
Const SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_VIEWPORT_PX As Double = 800#
Const SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_IMAGE_WIDTH_MIN As Long = 360
Const SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_IMAGE_WIDTH_MAX As Long = 1400
' abcjs typically fills ~80% of the image width with actual note content; the rest is margin.
' Dividing the slot-width estimate by this ratio compensates so content aligns with the viewport slot.
Const SCORE_EXPORT_CONTENT_FILL_RATIO As Double = 0.8#

' ============================================================
' ENTRY POINT
' ============================================================
' Reads the parts table (G:I, rows 2-25) and processes each row in order.
' The row with Type="metadata" provides the ABC header (title, key, meter…).
' The row with Type="melody" (or the first non-metadata row) clears the event
' table and writes the primary voice.  Every subsequent row is appended.
'
' Supported Type values:
'   metadata        — ABC header block (no events generated)
'   melody          — primary voice; voice defaults to "pipes"
'   harmony1        — first harmony; voice defaults to "harmony1"
'   harmony2        — second harmony; voice defaults to "harmony2"
'   transition_tail — tail splice: events tagged structure="tail" / "tail_bar"
'   transition_head — head splice: events tagged structure="head" / "head_bar"
'   bridge          — bridge/filler: events tagged structure="bridge" / "bridge_bar"
'   (transition melody rows) — use col J (Tail Add), col I (bridge), col K (Head Add)
'   (any other)     — appended with the supplied voice label
'
Public Sub ParseAllParts()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ActiveSheet  ' Operates on whichever sheet is active — no longer locked to "Tune"

    ResetMissingEmbellishmentTracking
    MergeSplitBarsForScore = False

    ' ---- Locate and parse metadata row ----
    Dim metadataABC As String
    Dim foundMetadataRow As Boolean
    Dim r As Long
    For r = PART_TABLE_FIRST_ROW To PART_TABLE_MAX_ROW
        If LCase$(Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_TYPE_COL).Value)) = "metadata" Then
            foundMetadataRow = True
            metadataABC = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_ABC_COL).Value)
            Exit For
        End If
    Next r

    If Not foundMetadataRow Then
        MsgBox "No metadata row found in parts table." & vbCrLf & _
               "Add a row with Type=metadata (col G) and the ABC header block in col I.", _
               vbExclamation, "Parse Error"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If metadataABC <> "" Then
        ParseABCMetadata ws, metadataABC
    End If
    MergeSplitBarsForScore = ParseMetadataBoolean(GetMetadataValue(ws, "score_merge_split_bars"))
    CalculateRhythmicConstants ws

    ' ---- Pre-parse structural validation ----
    ' Shows issues to the user and gives them the option to abort.
    If Not ValidateABCParts(ws) Then Exit Sub

    ' ---- Clear event table and reset state ----
    ClearEventRows ws
    PickupOffsetUnits = 0#
    PickupDetected = False
    AppendStartRow = 0
    ActiveVoice = ""

    ' ---- Process each part row ----
    Dim totalAdded As Long
    totalAdded = 0
    Dim partSummary As String
    partSummary = ""

    Dim isTransitionTune As Boolean
    isTransitionTune = (LCase$(Trim$(CStr(GetMetadataValue(ws, "rhythm")))) = "transition")

    For r = PART_TABLE_FIRST_ROW To PART_TABLE_MAX_ROW
        Dim partType As String
        Dim voiceTag  As String
        Dim abcText   As String
        Dim tailAddText As String
        Dim headAddText As String

        partType = LCase$(Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_TYPE_COL).Value))
        voiceTag  = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_VOICE_COL).Value)
        abcText   = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_ABC_COL).Value)
        tailAddText = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_TAIL_COL).Value)
        headAddText = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_HEAD_COL).Value)

        If partType = "" Or partType = "metadata" Then GoTo NextPartRow

        ' Transition worksheet format: melody row can provide three explicit segments.
        If isTransitionTune And partType = "melody" Then
            totalAdded = totalAdded + ParsePartSegment(ws, "transition_tail", voiceTag, tailAddText, partSummary)
            totalAdded = totalAdded + ParsePartSegment(ws, "bridge", voiceTag, abcText, partSummary)
            totalAdded = totalAdded + ParsePartSegment(ws, "transition_head", voiceTag, headAddText, partSummary)
        Else
            totalAdded = totalAdded + ParsePartSegment(ws, partType, voiceTag, abcText, partSummary)
        End If

NextPartRow:
    Next r

    AppendStartRow = 0
    ActiveVoice = ""

    If totalAdded = 0 Then
         MsgBox "No events were generated. Check that part rows (col G) have ABC in col I (and transition rows in J/K when used).", _
               vbExclamation, "Parse Error"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' ---- Post-processing over all written events ----
    DetectPickup ws
    RecalculatePositions ws
    PopulateEmbellishmentTargets ws
    InferStructuralMetadata ws
    RenumberEventIds ws
    Call InferBrokenRhythms()

    MsgBox "Parse complete — " & totalAdded & " total rows." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           partSummary & vbCrLf & _
           "Time sig: " & TimeSigNum & "/" & TimeSigDen & vbCrLf & _
           "Units/beat: " & Round(UnitsPerBeat, 4) & vbCrLf & _
           "Pickup units: " & Round(PickupOffsetUnits, 4), _
           vbInformation, "Parse Complete"

    ShowMissingEmbellishmentsSummary
End Sub

Private Function ParsePartSegment(ws As Worksheet, ByVal partType As String, ByVal voiceTag As String, ByVal abcText As String, ByRef partSummary As String) As Long
    ParsePartSegment = 0
    If Trim$(partType) = "" Then Exit Function
    If Trim$(abcText) = "" Then Exit Function

    Dim resolvedVoice As String
    resolvedVoice = Trim$(voiceTag)

    ' Default voice tag when col H is blank.
    If resolvedVoice = "" Then
        Select Case partType
            Case "melody":          resolvedVoice = "pipes"
            Case "harmony1":        resolvedVoice = "harmony1"
            Case "harmony2":        resolvedVoice = "harmony2"
            Case "transition_tail": resolvedVoice = "pipes"
            Case "transition_head": resolvedVoice = "pipes"
            Case "bridge":          resolvedVoice = "pipes"
            Case Else:               resolvedVoice = partType
        End Select
    End If

    ' Voice index for ABC voice-header extraction.
    Dim voiceIdx As String
    Select Case partType
        Case "harmony1": voiceIdx = "2"
        Case "harmony2": voiceIdx = "3"
        Case Else:         voiceIdx = "1"
    End Select

    If partType = "transition_tail" Or partType = "transition_head" Or partType = "bridge" Then
        abcText = NormalizeStandaloneTransitionABC(abcText)
    End If

    Dim preparedABC As String
    preparedABC = PrepareABCForVoice(abcText, voiceIdx)
    If Trim$(preparedABC) = "" Then Exit Function

    ' Snapshot last written row before appending.
    Dim rowBefore As Long
    rowBefore = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, COL_EVENT_ID).End(xlUp).Row
    If rowBefore < FIRST_DATA_ROW - 1 Then rowBefore = FIRST_DATA_ROW - 1

    ' Configure append state.
    AppendStartRow = IIf(rowBefore < FIRST_DATA_ROW, 0, rowBefore + 1)

    ' Use partType to drive channel routing for harmony parts.
    Select Case partType
        Case "harmony1", "harmony2", "harmony3"
            ActiveVoice = "pipes_" & partType
        Case Else
            ActiveVoice = IIf(resolvedVoice <> "", resolvedVoice, "pipes_melody")
    End Select

    PickupOffsetUnits = 0#
    PickupDetected = False

    ' Tokenise, expand repeats, write events.
    Dim tokens As Collection
    Set tokens = TokenizeABC(preparedABC)
    Dim flatTokens As Collection
    Set flatTokens = ExpandRepeats(tokens)
    WriteEventsFromTokens ws, flatTokens

    ' Tag transition/bridge events in COL_STRUCTURE.
    Dim sectionTag As String
    sectionTag = ""
    Select Case partType
        Case "transition_tail": sectionTag = "tail"
        Case "transition_head": sectionTag = "head"
        Case "bridge":          sectionTag = "bridge"
    End Select
    If sectionTag <> "" Then TagSectionEvents ws, rowBefore + 1, sectionTag

    ' Tally.
    Dim rowAfter As Long
    rowAfter = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, COL_EVENT_ID).End(xlUp).Row
    Dim addedCount As Long
    addedCount = rowAfter - rowBefore
    ParsePartSegment = addedCount

    partSummary = partSummary & "  " & partType & " (" & resolvedVoice & "): " & addedCount & " rows" & vbCrLf
End Function

Private Function ParseMetadataPositiveNumber(ByVal rawValue As Variant, ByVal fallbackValue As Double) As Double
    Dim s As String
    s = Trim$(CStr(rawValue))
    If s = "" Then
        ParseMetadataPositiveNumber = fallbackValue
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Not IsNumeric(s) Then
        ParseMetadataPositiveNumber = fallbackValue
        Exit Function
    End If

    ParseMetadataPositiveNumber = CDbl(s)
    If ParseMetadataPositiveNumber <= 0# Then ParseMetadataPositiveNumber = fallbackValue
End Function

Private Function ParseTempoDefaultBPM(ByVal tempoRaw As Variant, _
                                      ByRef beatUnitFraction As Double, _
                                      ByVal defaultBeatUnitFraction As Double) As Double
    Dim s As String
    s = Trim$(CStr(tempoRaw))

    beatUnitFraction = defaultBeatUnitFraction
    If beatUnitFraction <= 0# Then beatUnitFraction = 0.25

    If s = "" Then
        ParseTempoDefaultBPM = SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_BPM
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim eqPos As Long
    eqPos = InStr(1, s, "=", vbTextCompare)
    If eqPos > 0 Then
        Dim leftPart As String
        Dim rightPart As String
        leftPart = Trim$(Left$(s, eqPos - 1))
        rightPart = Trim$(Mid$(s, eqPos + 1))

        If leftPart <> "" Then
            Dim parsedFrac As Double
            parsedFrac = ParseFraction(leftPart)
            If parsedFrac > 0# Then beatUnitFraction = parsedFrac
        End If

        If IsNumeric(rightPart) Then
            ParseTempoDefaultBPM = CDbl(rightPart)
        Else
            ParseTempoDefaultBPM = SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_BPM
        End If
    ElseIf IsNumeric(s) Then
        ParseTempoDefaultBPM = CDbl(s)
    Else
        ParseTempoDefaultBPM = SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_BPM
    End If

    If ParseTempoDefaultBPM <= 0# Then ParseTempoDefaultBPM = SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_BPM
End Function

Private Function ResolveScoreExportImageWidth(ByVal ws As Worksheet) As Long
    ' Metadata overrides (all optional):
    ' - score_viewport_ahead_ms
    ' - score_viewport_behind_ms
    ' - score_viewport_px
    ' - score_image_width_min
    ' - score_image_width_max
    ' - score_image_width (fixed width override)

    Dim fixedWidth As Double
    fixedWidth = ParseMetadataPositiveNumber(GetMetadataValue(ws, "score_image_width"), 0#)
    If fixedWidth > 0# Then
        ResolveScoreExportImageWidth = CLng(Round(fixedWidth))
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim viewAheadMs As Double
    Dim viewBehindMs As Double
    Dim viewportPx As Double
    Dim minWidth As Double
    Dim maxWidth As Double

    viewAheadMs = ParseMetadataPositiveNumber(GetMetadataValue(ws, "score_viewport_ahead_ms"), SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_VIEW_AHEAD_MS)
    viewBehindMs = ParseMetadataPositiveNumber(GetMetadataValue(ws, "score_viewport_behind_ms"), SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_VIEW_BEHIND_MS)
    viewportPx = ParseMetadataPositiveNumber(GetMetadataValue(ws, "score_viewport_px"), SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_VIEWPORT_PX)
    minWidth = ParseMetadataPositiveNumber(GetMetadataValue(ws, "score_image_width_min"), SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_IMAGE_WIDTH_MIN)
    maxWidth = ParseMetadataPositiveNumber(GetMetadataValue(ws, "score_image_width_max"), SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_IMAGE_WIDTH_MAX)

    If maxWidth < minWidth Then
        Dim tmpW As Double
        tmpW = minWidth
        minWidth = maxWidth
        maxWidth = tmpW
    End If

    Dim tsNum As Double
    Dim tsDen As Double
    tsNum = ParseMetadataPositiveNumber(GetMetadataValue(ws, "time_sig_num"), 4#)
    tsDen = ParseMetadataPositiveNumber(GetMetadataValue(ws, "time_sig_den"), 4#)

    Dim beatUnitFraction As Double
    Dim defaultBeatFraction As Double
    defaultBeatFraction = 1# / tsDen

    Dim bpm As Double
    bpm = ParseTempoDefaultBPM(GetMetadataValue(ws, "tempo_default"), beatUnitFraction, defaultBeatFraction)

    Dim measureWhole As Double
    measureWhole = tsNum / tsDen
    If beatUnitFraction <= 0# Then beatUnitFraction = defaultBeatFraction
    If beatUnitFraction <= 0# Then beatUnitFraction = 0.25

    Dim beatsPerMeasureAtTempo As Double
    beatsPerMeasureAtTempo = measureWhole / beatUnitFraction
    If beatsPerMeasureAtTempo <= 0# Then beatsPerMeasureAtTempo = tsNum

    Dim measureMs As Double
    measureMs = beatsPerMeasureAtTempo * (60000# / bpm)

    Dim viewportMs As Double
    viewportMs = viewAheadMs + viewBehindMs
    If viewportMs <= 0# Then viewportMs = SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_VIEW_AHEAD_MS + SCORE_EXPORT_DEFAULT_VIEW_BEHIND_MS

    Dim pxPerMs As Double
    pxPerMs = viewportPx / viewportMs

    Dim suggestedWidth As Double
    suggestedWidth = (measureMs * pxPerMs) / SCORE_EXPORT_CONTENT_FILL_RATIO
    If suggestedWidth < minWidth Then suggestedWidth = minWidth
    If suggestedWidth > maxWidth Then suggestedWidth = maxWidth

    ResolveScoreExportImageWidth = CLng(Round(suggestedWidth))
End Function

Private Function NormalizeStandaloneTransitionABC(ByVal abcText As String) As String
    ' Transition tail/head fragments can legitimately inherit repeat context from the
    ' neighboring tune. When exported or validated in isolation, orphan repeat markers
    ' such as :| or |: should behave as plain barlines instead of raising false warnings
    ' or disappearing during repeat expansion.
    Dim outText As String
    outText = Trim$(abcText)

    If InStr(1, outText, "|:", vbBinaryCompare) = 0 And InStr(1, outText, ":|", vbBinaryCompare) > 0 Then
        outText = Replace(outText, ":|", "|")
    End If
    If InStr(1, outText, ":|", vbBinaryCompare) = 0 And InStr(1, outText, "|:", vbBinaryCompare) > 0 Then
        outText = Replace(outText, "|:", "|")
    End If

    NormalizeStandaloneTransitionABC = outText
End Function

' Tag all event rows in [firstRow .. last written row] with a transition section label.
' Bar-type rows get "<tag>_bar"; all other rows get "<tag>".
' This lets the GML stitcher filter events by section without ambiguity.
Private Sub TagSectionEvents(ws As Worksheet, ByVal firstRow As Long, ByVal sectionTag As String)
    Dim r As Long
    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, COL_EVENT_ID).End(xlUp).Row
    For r = firstRow To lastRow
        If ws.Cells(r, COL_EVENT_ID).Value = "" Then Exit For
        Dim currentStruct As String
        currentStruct = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, COL_STRUCTURE).Value)
        If currentStruct = "bar" Then
            ws.Cells(r, COL_STRUCTURE).Value = sectionTag & "_bar"
        Else
            ws.Cells(r, COL_STRUCTURE).Value = sectionTag
        End If
    Next r
End Sub


Private Sub RenumberEventIds(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim r As Long
    Dim newId As Long
    newId = 1
    r = FIRST_DATA_ROW
    Do While ws.Cells(r, COL_EVENT_ID).Value <> ""
        ws.Cells(r, COL_EVENT_ID).Value = newId
        newId = newId + 1
        r = r + 1
    Loop
End Sub

' ============================================================
' CALCULATE RHYTHMIC CONSTANTS FROM METADATA
' ============================================================

Private Sub CalculateRhythmicConstants(ws As Worksheet)
    ' Read time signature from metadata
    Dim tsNum As Variant, tsDen As Variant
    tsNum = GetMetadataValue(ws, "time_sig_num")
    tsDen = GetMetadataValue(ws, "time_sig_den")
    
    ' Default to 4/4 if not specified
    If IsEmpty(tsNum) Or tsNum = "" Then tsNum = 4
    If IsEmpty(tsDen) Or tsDen = "" Then tsDen = 4
    
    TimeSigNum = CLng(tsNum)
    TimeSigDen = CLng(tsDen)
    
    ' Read unit note length (L: field)
    Dim unitLen As String
    unitLen = GetMetadataValue(ws, "unit_note_length")
    
    ' Parse unit note length (e.g., "1/8" -> 0.125)
    UnitNoteFraction = ParseFraction(unitLen)
    If UnitNoteFraction = 0 Then UnitNoteFraction = 0.125  ' Default to 1/8
    
    ' Calculate beats per measure = numerator of time signature
    BeatsPerMeasure = TimeSigNum
    
    ' Calculate units per beat:
    ' A "beat" is one denominator note (e.g., quarter note in x/4 time)
    ' Beat duration as fraction = 1/TimeSigDen (e.g., 1/4 for quarter note)
    ' Units per beat = beat duration / unit duration
    ' e.g., for 7/4 with L:1/8: beat = 1/4, unit = 1/8, so units per beat = (1/4)/(1/8) = 2
    Dim beatFraction As Double
    beatFraction = 1# / CDbl(TimeSigDen)
    UnitsPerBeat = beatFraction / UnitNoteFraction
    
    ' Calculate units per measure
    UnitsPerMeasure = UnitsPerBeat * CDbl(BeatsPerMeasure)
End Sub

Private Function GetMetadataValue(ws As Worksheet, ByVal variableName As String) As Variant
    Dim r As Long
    For r = 2 To 48
        If LCase(Trim(ws.Cells(r, 2).Value)) = LCase(variableName) Then
            GetMetadataValue = ws.Cells(r, 3).Value
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next r
    GetMetadataValue = ""
End Function

Private Function ParseFraction(ByVal fracStr As String) As Double
    ' Parse a fraction string like "1/8" into a decimal
    fracStr = Trim(fracStr)
    If fracStr = "" Then
        ParseFraction = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Dim parts() As String
    parts = Split(fracStr, "/")
    
    If UBound(parts) = 0 Then
        ' No slash - it's a whole number
        ParseFraction = CDbl(parts(0))
    ElseIf UBound(parts) = 1 Then
        ' Has slash - it's a fraction
        Dim num As Double, den As Double
        num = CDbl(Trim(parts(0)))
        den = CDbl(Trim(parts(1)))
        If den <> 0 Then
            ParseFraction = num / den
        Else
            ParseFraction = 0
        End If
    Else
        ParseFraction = 0
    End If
End Function

' ============================================================
' DETECT PICKUP (ANACRUSIS)
' ============================================================

Private Sub DetectPickup(ws As Worksheet)
    BuildBarPhaseMap ws

    If DownbeatBarCount <= 0 Then
        PickupOffsetUnits = 0
        PickupDetected = False
        Exit Sub
    End If

    PickupOffsetUnits = DownbeatBarUnits(1)
    PickupDetected = (PickupOffsetUnits > EPSILON)
End Sub

Private Sub BuildBarPhaseMap(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim rowIndex As Long
    rowIndex = FIRST_DATA_ROW

    Dim barUnits() As Double
    Dim barCount As Long
    barCount = 0

    Do While ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EVENT_ID).Value <> ""
        If LCase$(Trim$(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TYPE).Value)) = "structure" And _
           LCase$(Trim$(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_STRUCTURE).Value)) = "bar" Then
            Dim u As Double
            u = CDbl(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TOTAL_UNITS).Value)
            If u > EPSILON Then
                If barCount = 0 Then
                    barCount = barCount + 1
                    ReDim Preserve barUnits(1 To barCount)
                    barUnits(barCount) = u
                ElseIf Abs(u - barUnits(barCount)) > EPSILON Then
                    barCount = barCount + 1
                    ReDim Preserve barUnits(1 To barCount)
                    barUnits(barCount) = u
                End If
            End If
        End If
        rowIndex = rowIndex + 1
    Loop

    DownbeatBarCount = 0
    Erase DownbeatBarUnits
    If barCount = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim effectiveMeasureUnits As Double
    effectiveMeasureUnits = UnitsPerMeasure

    Dim firstGap As Double
    Dim foundFirstGap As Boolean
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To barCount
        firstGap = barUnits(i) - barUnits(i - 1)
        If firstGap > EPSILON Then
            foundFirstGap = True
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i
    If foundFirstGap Then
        effectiveMeasureUnits = firstGap
    End If

    Dim hasInitialPickup As Boolean
    hasInitialPickup = (barUnits(1) < (effectiveMeasureUnits - EPSILON))

    Dim tol As Double
    tol = IIf(effectiveMeasureUnits > 0, effectiveMeasureUnits * 0.2, 0.2)
    If tol < 0.2 Then tol = 0.2

    ' If there is no opening pickup, measure 1 starts at unit 0.
    If Not hasInitialPickup Then
        DownbeatBarCount = 1
        ReDim Preserve DownbeatBarUnits(1 To DownbeatBarCount)
        DownbeatBarUnits(DownbeatBarCount) = 0#
    End If

    For i = 1 To barCount
        Dim isDownbeat As Boolean
        isDownbeat = False

        If i = 1 And hasInitialPickup Then
            isDownbeat = True
        End If

        Dim prevGap As Double
        Dim nextGap As Double
        prevGap = -1
        nextGap = -1

        If i > 1 Then prevGap = barUnits(i) - barUnits(i - 1)
        If i < barCount Then nextGap = barUnits(i + 1) - barUnits(i)

        If Not isDownbeat Then
            If prevGap > EPSILON And Abs(prevGap - effectiveMeasureUnits) <= tol Then
                isDownbeat = True
            End If
        End If

        If Not isDownbeat Then
            If nextGap > EPSILON And Abs(nextGap - effectiveMeasureUnits) <= tol Then
                isDownbeat = True
            End If
        End If

        If isDownbeat Then
            If DownbeatBarCount > 0 Then
                If Abs(barUnits(i) - DownbeatBarUnits(DownbeatBarCount)) <= EPSILON Then
                    GoTo NextBarMap
                End If
            End If
            DownbeatBarCount = DownbeatBarCount + 1
            ReDim Preserve DownbeatBarUnits(1 To DownbeatBarCount)
            DownbeatBarUnits(DownbeatBarCount) = barUnits(i)
        End If
NextBarMap:
    Next i
End Sub

' ============================================================
' ABC STRUCTURE VALIDATOR
' ============================================================
' Checks that the parts table ABC is structurally sound before
' parsing begins.  Catches issues the parser would otherwise
' silently ignore or mishandle:
'   1. Required header fields  M:  L:  K:
'   2. Balanced embellishment braces  { }
'   3. Balanced repeat brackets  |: … :|
'   4. Measure beat-count integrity  (notes-per-bar vs time sig)
'
' Public Sub ValidateABC  — callable from a worksheet button.
' Public Function ValidateABCParts  — called by ParseAllParts
'   as a pre-flight gate; returns True to allow parsing to proceed.

Public Sub ValidateABC()
    ValidateABCParts ActiveSheet
End Sub

Public Function ValidateABCParts(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean
    Dim report As String
    report = ""
    Dim errCount As Long
    errCount = 0
    Dim warnCount As Long
    warnCount = 0
    Dim hasFatalUnknownEmbellishment As Boolean
    hasFatalUnknownEmbellishment = False

    ResetMissingEmbellishmentTracking

    ' ---- 1. Metadata / header checks ----
    Dim metadataABC As String
    Dim foundMeta As Boolean
    Dim r As Long
    For r = PART_TABLE_FIRST_ROW To PART_TABLE_MAX_ROW
        If LCase$(Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_TYPE_COL).Value)) = "metadata" Then
            foundMeta = True
            metadataABC = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_ABC_COL).Value)
            Exit For
        End If
    Next r

    If Not foundMeta Or metadataABC = "" Then
        report = report & "[ERROR] No metadata row (Type=metadata) with ABC text found." & vbCrLf
        errCount = errCount + 1
    Else
        If Not ABCHasHeader(metadataABC, "M") Then
            report = report & "[ERROR] Metadata missing M: (meter/time signature)." & vbCrLf
            errCount = errCount + 1
        End If
        If Not ABCHasHeader(metadataABC, "L") Then
            report = report & "[ERROR] Metadata missing L: (unit note length)." & vbCrLf
            errCount = errCount + 1
        End If
        If Not ABCHasHeader(metadataABC, "K") Then
            report = report & "[WARN]  Metadata missing K: (key signature)." & vbCrLf
            warnCount = warnCount + 1
        End If
    End If

    ' Rhythmic constants needed for measure-length checks.
    ' Safe to call even when errCount > 0; uses whatever is already in cells.
    CalculateRhythmicConstants ws
    Dim canCheckMeasures As Boolean
    canCheckMeasures = (errCount = 0 And UnitsPerMeasure > EPSILON)

    ' ---- 2. Per-part checks ----
    Dim partCount As Long
    partCount = 0
    Dim isTransitionTune As Boolean
    isTransitionTune = (LCase$(Trim$(CStr(GetMetadataValue(ws, "rhythm")))) = "transition")
    Dim hasTailAdd As Boolean
    Dim hasHeadAdd As Boolean

    For r = PART_TABLE_FIRST_ROW To PART_TABLE_MAX_ROW
        Dim partType As String
        partType = LCase$(Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_TYPE_COL).Value))
        If partType = "" Or partType = "metadata" Then GoTo NextValidPart

        Dim abcText As String
        Dim tailText As String
        Dim headText As String
        abcText = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_ABC_COL).Value)
        tailText = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_TAIL_COL).Value)
        headText = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_HEAD_COL).Value)

        If isTransitionTune And partType = "melody" Then
            Dim segResult As String

            If tailText <> "" Then
                hasTailAdd = True
                partCount = partCount + 1
                segResult = CheckABCText(NormalizeStandaloneTransitionABC(tailText), canCheckMeasures, errCount, warnCount)
                If segResult <> "" Then report = report & "Part [transition_tail]:" & vbCrLf & segResult
                segResult = CheckUnknownEmbellishments(NormalizeStandaloneTransitionABC(tailText), ws.Parent, warnCount, hasFatalUnknownEmbellishment)
                If segResult <> "" Then report = report & "Part [transition_tail]:" & vbCrLf & segResult
            End If

            If abcText <> "" Then
                partCount = partCount + 1
                segResult = CheckABCText(NormalizeStandaloneTransitionABC(abcText), canCheckMeasures, errCount, warnCount)
                If segResult <> "" Then report = report & "Part [bridge]:" & vbCrLf & segResult
                segResult = CheckUnknownEmbellishments(NormalizeStandaloneTransitionABC(abcText), ws.Parent, warnCount, hasFatalUnknownEmbellishment)
                If segResult <> "" Then report = report & "Part [bridge]:" & vbCrLf & segResult
            End If

            If headText <> "" Then
                hasHeadAdd = True
                partCount = partCount + 1
                segResult = CheckABCText(NormalizeStandaloneTransitionABC(headText), canCheckMeasures, errCount, warnCount)
                If segResult <> "" Then report = report & "Part [transition_head]:" & vbCrLf & segResult
                segResult = CheckUnknownEmbellishments(NormalizeStandaloneTransitionABC(headText), ws.Parent, warnCount, hasFatalUnknownEmbellishment)
                If segResult <> "" Then report = report & "Part [transition_head]:" & vbCrLf & segResult
            End If
        Else
            If abcText = "" Then GoTo NextValidPart
            partCount = partCount + 1
            Dim partResult As String
            partResult = CheckABCText(abcText, canCheckMeasures, errCount, warnCount)
            If partResult <> "" Then
                report = report & "Part [" & partType & "]:" & vbCrLf & partResult
            End If
            partResult = CheckUnknownEmbellishments(abcText, ws.Parent, warnCount, hasFatalUnknownEmbellishment)
            If partResult <> "" Then
                report = report & "Part [" & partType & "]:" & vbCrLf & partResult
            End If
        End If

NextValidPart:
    Next r

    If isTransitionTune Then
        Dim tailCutMeasures As Double
        Dim headCutMeasures As Double
        tailCutMeasures = ParseNonNegativeMetadataNumber(GetMetadataValue(ws, "tail_cut_measures"))
        headCutMeasures = ParseNonNegativeMetadataNumber(GetMetadataValue(ws, "head_cut_measures"))

        If hasTailAdd And tailCutMeasures <= 0 Then
            report = report & "[WARN]  Transition tail content exists (col J) but tail_cut_measures is blank/zero." & vbCrLf
            warnCount = warnCount + 1
        End If
        If hasHeadAdd And headCutMeasures <= 0 Then
            report = report & "[WARN]  Transition head content exists (col K) but head_cut_measures is blank/zero." & vbCrLf
            warnCount = warnCount + 1
        End If
        If (Not hasTailAdd) And tailCutMeasures > 0 Then
            report = report & "[WARN]  tail_cut_measures is set but transition tail content (col J) is empty." & vbCrLf
            warnCount = warnCount + 1
        End If
        If (Not hasHeadAdd) And headCutMeasures > 0 Then
            report = report & "[WARN]  head_cut_measures is set but transition head content (col K) is empty." & vbCrLf
            warnCount = warnCount + 1
        End If
    End If

    If partCount = 0 Then
        report = report & "[ERROR] No part rows with ABC content found." & vbCrLf
        errCount = errCount + 1
    End If

    ' ---- Result ----
    Dim summary As String
    summary = partCount & " part(s) checked.  Time sig: " & TimeSigNum & "/" & TimeSigDen & _
              "  Units/measure: " & Round(UnitsPerMeasure, 4)

    If errCount = 0 And warnCount = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Validation passed — no issues found." & vbCrLf & summary, _
               vbInformation, "ABC Validation"
        ValidateABCParts = True
    ElseIf errCount = 0 Then
        MsgBox warnCount & " warning(s):" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & report & vbCrLf & summary, _
               vbExclamation, "ABC Validation"
        ValidateABCParts = True
    Else
        Dim choice As Long
        choice = MsgBox(errCount & " error(s), " & warnCount & " warning(s):" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                        report & vbCrLf & summary & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                        "Proceed with parsing anyway?", _
                        vbCritical + vbYesNo, "ABC Validation — Errors Found")
        ValidateABCParts = (choice = vbYes)
    End If
End Function

Private Function CheckUnknownEmbellishments(ByVal abcText As String, _
                                            ByVal wb As Workbook, _
                                            ByRef warnCount As Long, _
                                            ByRef hasFatalUnknownEmbellishment As Boolean) As String
    Dim result As String
    result = ""

    Dim prepared As String
    prepared = PrepareABCForVoice(abcText, "")
    If Trim$(prepared) = "" Then
        CheckUnknownEmbellishments = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim tokens As Collection
    Set tokens = TokenizeABC(prepared)
    Dim flat As Collection
    Set flat = ExpandRepeats(tokens)

    Dim hasAnyEmbellishments As Boolean
    hasAnyEmbellishments = False

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To flat.Count
        If CStr(flat(i)(1)) = "embellishment" Then
            hasAnyEmbellishments = True
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i

    If Not hasAnyEmbellishments Then
        CheckUnknownEmbellishments = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim libWs As Worksheet
    Set libWs = ResolveEmbellishmentsSheet(wb)

    If libWs Is Nothing Then
        result = result & "  [ERROR] Could not find an embellishment library sheet (expected name: Embellishments)." & vbCrLf
        warnCount = warnCount + 1
        hasFatalUnknownEmbellishment = True
        CheckUnknownEmbellishments = result
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim missing As Object
    Set missing = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    For i = 1 To flat.Count
        Dim t As Variant
        t = flat(i)

        If CStr(t(1)) = "embellishment" Then
            Dim pattern As String
            pattern = NormalizeEmbellishmentPattern(CStr(t(2)))

            Dim target As String
            target = FindNextTargetNoteFromTokens(flat, i + 1)

            If Not EmbellishmentExistsInLibrary(libWs, pattern, target) Then
                Dim key As String
                key = pattern & "|" & target

                If missing.Exists(key) Then
                    missing(key) = CLng(missing(key)) + 1
                Else
                    missing.Add key, 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If missing.Count > 0 Then
        Dim k As Variant
        For Each k In missing.Keys
            Dim sepPos As Long
            sepPos = InStr(1, CStr(k), "|", vbBinaryCompare)

            Dim kPattern As String
            Dim kTarget As String
            If sepPos > 0 Then
                kPattern = Left$(CStr(k), sepPos - 1)
                kTarget = Mid$(CStr(k), sepPos + 1)
            Else
                kPattern = CStr(k)
                kTarget = ""
            End If

            result = result & "  [ERROR] Unknown embellishment pattern='" & kPattern & "'"
            If kTarget <> "" Then
                result = result & " target='" & kTarget & "'"
            Else
                result = result & " target='(none)'"
            End If
            result = result & " occurrences=" & CStr(missing(k)) & ". Add this to the Embellishments sheet." & vbCrLf

            warnCount = warnCount + 1
            TrackMissingEmbellishment kPattern, kTarget, CLng(missing(k))
        Next k

        hasFatalUnknownEmbellishment = True
    End If

    CheckUnknownEmbellishments = result
End Function

Private Sub ResetMissingEmbellishmentTracking()
    Set MissingEmbellishmentsMap = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
End Sub

Private Sub TrackMissingEmbellishment(ByVal pattern As String, ByVal target As String, ByVal occurrences As Long)
    If MissingEmbellishmentsMap Is Nothing Then
        ResetMissingEmbellishmentTracking
    End If

    Dim key As String
    key = pattern & "|" & target

    If MissingEmbellishmentsMap.Exists(key) Then
        MissingEmbellishmentsMap(key) = CLng(MissingEmbellishmentsMap(key)) + occurrences
    Else
        MissingEmbellishmentsMap.Add key, occurrences
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub ShowMissingEmbellishmentsSummary()
    If MissingEmbellishmentsMap Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If MissingEmbellishmentsMap.Count <= 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim msg As String
    msg = "Missing embellishments found:" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf

    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In MissingEmbellishmentsMap.Keys
        Dim pairText As String
        pairText = CStr(k)

        Dim sepPos As Long
        sepPos = InStr(1, pairText, "|", vbBinaryCompare)

        Dim pat As String
        Dim tgt As String
        If sepPos > 0 Then
            pat = Left$(pairText, sepPos - 1)
            tgt = Mid$(pairText, sepPos + 1)
        Else
            pat = pairText
            tgt = ""
        End If

        msg = msg & "- pattern='" & pat & "'"
        If tgt <> "" Then
            msg = msg & " target='" & tgt & "'"
        Else
            msg = msg & " target='(none)'"
        End If
        msg = msg & " occurrences=" & CStr(MissingEmbellishmentsMap(k)) & vbCrLf
    Next k

    msg = msg & vbCrLf & "Parsing continued. Add these entries to the Embellishments sheet."

    MsgBox msg, vbExclamation, "Missing Embellishments"
End Sub

Private Function ResolveEmbellishmentsSheet(ByVal wb As Workbook) As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ResolveEmbellishmentsSheet = wb.Worksheets("Embellishments")
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Private Function NormalizeEmbellishmentPattern(ByVal rawPattern As String) As String
    Dim s As String
    s = Trim$(rawPattern)
    s = Replace(s, "{", "")
    s = Replace(s, "}", "")
    s = Replace(s, " ", "")
    NormalizeEmbellishmentPattern = s
End Function

Private Function FindNextTargetNoteFromTokens(ByVal flat As Collection, ByVal startIndex As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = startIndex To flat.Count
        Dim t As Variant
        t = flat(i)

        If CStr(t(1)) = "note" Then
            Dim letter As String
            letter = GetNoteLetterOnly(CStr(t(2)))
            If LCase$(letter) <> "z" And letter <> "" Then
                FindNextTargetNoteFromTokens = letter
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    FindNextTargetNoteFromTokens = ""
End Function

Private Function EmbellishmentExistsInLibrary(ByVal libWs As Worksheet, _
                                              ByVal pattern As String, _
                                              ByVal target As String) As Boolean
    If Trim$(pattern) = "" Then
        EmbellishmentExistsInLibrary = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim r As Long
    r = EMBELLISH_LIBRARY_FIRST_ROW

    Do While Trim$(CStr(libWs.Cells(r, EMBELLISH_LIBRARY_ID_COL).Value)) <> ""
        Dim libPattern As String
        libPattern = NormalizeEmbellishmentPattern(CStr(libWs.Cells(r, EMBELLISH_LIBRARY_PATTERN_COL).Value))

        If libPattern = pattern Then
            Dim libTarget As String
            libTarget = Trim$(CStr(libWs.Cells(r, EMBELLISH_LIBRARY_TARGET_COL).Value))

            If libTarget = "" Or libTarget = target Then
                EmbellishmentExistsInLibrary = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If

        r = r + 1
    Loop

    EmbellishmentExistsInLibrary = False
End Function

Private Function ParseNonNegativeMetadataNumber(ByVal rawValue As Variant) As Double
    Dim s As String
    s = Trim$(CStr(rawValue))
    If s = "" Then
        ParseNonNegativeMetadataNumber = 0#
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Not IsNumeric(s) Then
        ParseNonNegativeMetadataNumber = 0#
        Exit Function
    End If

    ParseNonNegativeMetadataNumber = CDbl(s)
    If ParseNonNegativeMetadataNumber < 0# Then ParseNonNegativeMetadataNumber = 0#
End Function

Private Function ParseMetadataBoolean(ByVal rawValue As Variant) As Boolean
    Dim s As String
    s = LCase$(Trim$(CStr(rawValue)))

    Select Case s
        Case "true", "1", "yes", "y", "on"
            ParseMetadataBoolean = True
    End Select
End Function

' Returns True if the ABC header block contains a header line for the given letter (e.g. "M", "L", "K").
Private Function ABCHasHeader(ByVal abc As String, ByVal letter As String) As Boolean
    Dim lines() As String
    lines = Split(Replace(Replace(abc, vbCrLf, vbLf), vbCr, vbLf), vbLf)
    Dim i As Long
    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)
        Dim ln As String
        ln = Trim$(lines(i))
        If Len(ln) >= 2 And Mid$(ln, 2, 1) = ":" Then
            If UCase$(Left$(ln, 1)) = UCase$(letter) Then
                ABCHasHeader = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    ABCHasHeader = False
End Function

' Validates one part's ABC text: balanced braces, balanced repeats, and measure lengths.
Private Function CheckABCText(ByVal abcText As String, ByVal checkMeasures As Boolean, _
                               ByRef errCount As Long, ByRef warnCount As Long) As String
    Dim result As String
    result = ""
    Dim prepared As String
    prepared = PrepareABCForVoice(abcText, "")

    ' ---- a. Balanced embellishments { } ----
    Dim braceDepth As Long
    braceDepth = 0
    Dim ci As Long
    For ci = 1 To Len(prepared)
        Dim ch As String
        ch = Mid$(prepared, ci, 1)
        If ch = "{" Then braceDepth = braceDepth + 1
        If ch = "}" Then
            braceDepth = braceDepth - 1
            If braceDepth < 0 Then
                result = result & "  [ERROR] Unmatched } at position " & ci & " (no preceding {)." & vbCrLf
                errCount = errCount + 1
                braceDepth = 0
            End If
        End If
    Next ci
    If braceDepth > 0 Then
        result = result & "  [ERROR] " & braceDepth & " unclosed { embellishment bracket(s)." & vbCrLf
        errCount = errCount + 1
    End If

    ' ---- b. Balanced repeat blocks |: :| ----
    Dim repeatDepth As Long
    repeatDepth = 0
    Dim ri As Long
    For ri = 1 To Len(prepared) - 1
        Dim c1 As String, c2 As String
        c1 = Mid$(prepared, ri, 1)
        c2 = Mid$(prepared, ri + 1, 1)
        If c1 = "|" And c2 = ":" Then
            repeatDepth = repeatDepth + 1
        ElseIf c1 = ":" And c2 = "|" Then
            repeatDepth = repeatDepth - 1
            If repeatDepth < 0 Then
                result = result & "  [ERROR] :| at position " & ri & " has no matching |:." & vbCrLf
                errCount = errCount + 1
                repeatDepth = 0
            End If
        End If
    Next ri
    If repeatDepth > 0 Then
        result = result & "  [ERROR] " & repeatDepth & " unclosed |: repeat block(s) — missing :|." & vbCrLf
        errCount = errCount + 1
    End If

    ' ---- c. Tie integrity ----
    Dim tieResult As String
    tieResult = CheckTieIntegrity(prepared, errCount, warnCount)
    If tieResult <> "" Then result = result & tieResult

    ' ---- d. Measure beat counts ----
    If checkMeasures And Trim$(prepared) <> "" Then
        Dim measureResult As String
        measureResult = CheckMeasureLengths(prepared, errCount, warnCount)
        If measureResult <> "" Then result = result & measureResult
    End If

    CheckABCText = result
End Function

' Validates tie usage for v1 parser support:
' - Tie marker must be attached to a note token (e.g., c- or c1/2-)
' - Tied note must be followed by another note
' - Tie target must be the same note letter
' - Ties on rests are not supported
Private Function CheckTieIntegrity(ByVal prepared As String, _
                                   ByRef errCount As Long, _
                                   ByRef warnCount As Long) As String
    Dim result As String
    result = ""

    Dim tokens As Collection
    Set tokens = TokenizeABC(prepared)
    Dim flat As Collection
    Set flat = ExpandRepeats(tokens)

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To flat.Count
        Dim t As Variant
        t = flat(i)

        If CStr(t(1)) = "note" Then
            Dim rawNote As String
            rawNote = CStr(t(2))

            If HasTieForward(rawNote) Then
                Dim srcClean As String
                srcClean = StripTieMarker(rawNote)

                Dim srcLetter As String
                srcLetter = GetNoteLetterOnly(srcClean)

                If srcLetter = "" Or LCase$(srcLetter) = "z" Then
                    result = result & "  [ERROR] Tie marker '-' cannot be applied to a rest token ('" & rawNote & "')." & vbCrLf
                    errCount = errCount + 1
                    GoTo NextTieToken
                End If

                If i >= flat.Count Then
                    result = result & "  [ERROR] Dangling tie at end of part after note '" & srcClean & "-'." & vbCrLf
                    errCount = errCount + 1
                    GoTo NextTieToken
                End If

                Dim n As Variant
                n = flat(i + 1)
                If CStr(n(1)) <> "note" Then
                    result = result & "  [ERROR] Tie after note '" & srcClean & "-' must be followed by another note." & vbCrLf
                    errCount = errCount + 1
                    GoTo NextTieToken
                End If

                Dim dstClean As String
                dstClean = StripTieMarker(CStr(n(2)))
                Dim dstLetter As String
                dstLetter = GetNoteLetterOnly(dstClean)

                If dstLetter = "" Or LCase$(dstLetter) = "z" Then
                    result = result & "  [ERROR] Tie target after note '" & srcClean & "-' cannot be a rest." & vbCrLf
                    errCount = errCount + 1
                    GoTo NextTieToken
                End If

                If dstLetter <> srcLetter Then
                    result = result & "  [ERROR] Tie mismatch: '" & srcClean & "-' cannot tie to '" & dstClean & "'." & vbCrLf
                    errCount = errCount + 1
                    GoTo NextTieToken
                End If
            End If
        End If
NextTieToken:
    Next i

    CheckTieIntegrity = result
End Function

' Tokenizes and expands the prepared ABC, then checks each measure's note-unit sum.
' Allows short first segment and segments immediately after || (pickup positions).
' Mirrors the tuplet-ratio logic in WriteEventsFromTokens exactly.
Private Function CheckMeasureLengths(ByVal prepared As String, _
                                     ByRef errCount As Long, ByRef warnCount As Long) As String
    Dim result As String
    result = ""
    If UnitsPerMeasure <= EPSILON Then Exit Function

    Dim tol As Double
    tol = UnitsPerMeasure * 0.15
    If tol < 0.1 Then tol = 0.1

    Dim tokens As Collection
    Set tokens = TokenizeABC(prepared)
    Dim flat As Collection
    Set flat = ExpandRepeats(tokens)

    ' Verify at least one note exists after expansion.
    Dim hasNotes As Boolean
    hasNotes = False
    Dim ti As Long
    For ti = 1 To flat.Count
        If flat(ti)(1) = "note" Then
            hasNotes = True
            Exit For
        End If
    Next ti
    If Not hasNotes Then
        result = result & "  [ERROR] No notes found after repeat expansion." & vbCrLf
        errCount = errCount + 1
        CheckMeasureLengths = result
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim accumUnits As Double
    accumUnits = 0#
    Dim measureNum As Long
    measureNum = 0
    Dim isFirstSegment As Boolean
    isFirstSegment = True
    Dim afterSectionBoundary As Boolean
    afterSectionBoundary = False

    ' Tuplet state — mirrors WriteEventsFromTokens.
    Dim inTuplet As Boolean
    inTuplet = False
    Dim tupletRatio As Double
    tupletRatio = 1#
    Dim tupletRemaining As Long
    tupletRemaining = 0

    For ti = 1 To flat.Count
        Dim tok As Variant
        tok = flat(ti)

        Select Case tok(1)

            Case "tuplet"
                Dim tn As Long
                tn = CLng(Mid$(tok(2), 2, 1))
                inTuplet = True
                tupletRemaining = tn
                Select Case tn
                    Case 2: tupletRatio = 1.5
                    Case 3: tupletRatio = 2# / 3#
                    Case 4: tupletRatio = 0.75
                    Case Else: tupletRatio = CDbl(tn - 1) / CDbl(tn)
                End Select

            Case "tuplet_end"
                inTuplet = False
                tupletRatio = 1#
                tupletRemaining = 0

            Case "note"
                Dim nd As Double
                nd = GetNoteDurationUnits(tok(2))
                If inTuplet Then
                    nd = nd * tupletRatio
                    tupletRemaining = tupletRemaining - 1
                    If tupletRemaining <= 0 Then
                        inTuplet = False
                        tupletRatio = 1#
                    End If
                End If
                accumUnits = accumUnits + nd

            Case "bar", "double_bar", "end_bar", "start_bar"
                Dim isPickupPos As Boolean
                isPickupPos = (isFirstSegment Or afterSectionBoundary)

                Dim allowsLeadingPickupToNextSection As Boolean
                allowsLeadingPickupToNextSection = (tok(1) = "double_bar" Or tok(1) = "end_bar" Or tok(1) = "start_bar")

                If isPickupPos Then
                    ' Short is expected and valid; only flag if overlong.
                    If accumUnits > UnitsPerMeasure + tol Then
                        result = result & "  [ERROR] Pickup/section-start overflows " & _
                                  "(segment ~" & measureNum + 1 & ": " & Format(accumUnits, "0.###") & _
                                  " units, max " & Format(UnitsPerMeasure, "0.###") & ")." & vbCrLf
                        errCount = errCount + 1
                    End If
                Else
                    If accumUnits > UnitsPerMeasure + tol Then
                        result = result & "  [ERROR] Expanded segment " & measureNum & " too long (" & _
                                  Format(accumUnits, "0.###") & " units, expected " & _
                                  Format(UnitsPerMeasure, "0.###") & ")." & vbCrLf
                        errCount = errCount + 1
                    ElseIf accumUnits < UnitsPerMeasure - tol And Not allowsLeadingPickupToNextSection Then
                        result = result & "  [WARN]  Expanded segment " & measureNum & " too short (" & _
                                  Format(accumUnits, "0.###") & " units, expected " & _
                                  Format(UnitsPerMeasure, "0.###") & ")." & vbCrLf
                        warnCount = warnCount + 1
                    End If
                End If

                measureNum = measureNum + 1
                accumUnits = 0#
                isFirstSegment = False
                inTuplet = False
                tupletRatio = 1#
                tupletRemaining = 0
                afterSectionBoundary = (tok(1) = "double_bar" Or tok(1) = "end_bar" Or tok(1) = "start_bar")

        End Select
    Next ti

    ' Any trailing notes after the final barline.
    If accumUnits > EPSILON And Not isFirstSegment Then
        If accumUnits > UnitsPerMeasure + tol Then
            result = result & "  [ERROR] Final segment too long (" & _
                      Format(accumUnits, "0.###") & " units)." & vbCrLf
            errCount = errCount + 1
        End If
        ' Short final segment is OK (no trailing barline is common).
    End If

    CheckMeasureLengths = result
End Function

' ============================================================
' CLEAR EVENT TABLE
' ============================================================

Private Sub ClearEventRows(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, COL_EVENT_ID).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow >= FIRST_DATA_ROW Then
        ws.Rows(FIRST_DATA_ROW & ":" & lastRow).ClearContents
    End If
End Sub

Private Function PrepareABCForVoice(ByVal abc As String, Optional ByVal desiredVoice As String = "") As String
    Dim normalized As String
    normalized = Replace(abc, vbCrLf, vbLf)
    normalized = Replace(normalized, vbCr, vbLf)

    Dim lines() As String
    lines = Split(normalized, vbLf)

    Dim hasVoiceHeaders As Boolean
    Dim i As Long
    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)
        If IsVoiceHeaderLine(lines(i)) Then
            hasVoiceHeaders = True
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i

    Dim currentVoice As String
    Dim result As String
    result = ""

    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)
        Dim line As String
        line = Trim$(lines(i))

        If line = "" Then GoTo NextPrepareLine
        If Left$(line, 1) = "%" Then GoTo NextPrepareLine
        If IsMetadataHeaderLine(line) Then GoTo NextPrepareLine

        If IsVoiceHeaderLine(line) Then
            currentVoice = ParseVoiceId(line)
            GoTo NextPrepareLine
        End If

        If hasVoiceHeaders Then
            If desiredVoice = "" Or currentVoice = desiredVoice Then
                If result <> "" Then result = result & " "
                result = result & line
            End If
        Else
            If result <> "" Then result = result & " "
            result = result & line
        End If

NextPrepareLine:
    Next i

    PrepareABCForVoice = Trim$(result)
End Function

Private Function IsVoiceHeaderLine(ByVal line As String) As Boolean
    Dim trimmedLine As String
    trimmedLine = LCase$(Trim$(line))
    IsVoiceHeaderLine = (Len(trimmedLine) >= 2 And Left$(trimmedLine, 2) = "v:")
End Function

Private Function ParseVoiceId(ByVal line As String) As String
    Dim payload As String
    payload = Trim$(Mid$(Trim$(line), 3))

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To Len(payload)
        Dim ch As String
        ch = Mid$(payload, i, 1)
        If ch = " " Or ch = vbTab Then
            ParseVoiceId = Left$(payload, i - 1)
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i

    ParseVoiceId = payload
End Function

Private Function IsMetadataHeaderLine(ByVal line As String) As Boolean
    Dim trimmedLine As String
    trimmedLine = Trim$(line)

    If Len(trimmedLine) < 2 Then Exit Function
    If Mid$(trimmedLine, 2, 1) <> ":" Then Exit Function

    Select Case UCase$(Left$(trimmedLine, 1))
        Case "X", "T", "C", "M", "L", "R", "Q", "K", "N", "Z", "P", "G", "A", "B", "D", "F", "H", "I", "O", "S", "W", "U"
            IsMetadataHeaderLine = True
    End Select
End Function

' ============================================================
' TOKENIZATION
' ============================================================

Private Function TokenizeABC(ByVal abc As String) As Collection
    Dim tokens As New Collection
    Dim i As Long, ch As String, nextCh As String

    i = 1
    Do While i <= Len(abc)
        ch = Mid$(abc, i, 1)

        If ch = " " Or ch = vbTab Or ch = vbCr Or ch = vbLf Then
            i = i + 1
            GoTo ContinueLoop
        End If

        If ch = "{" Then
            Dim j As Long
            j = InStr(i, abc, "}")
            If j = 0 Then
                AddToken tokens, "unknown", ch
                i = i + 1
            Else
                AddToken tokens, "embellishment", Mid$(abc, i, j - i + 1)
                i = j + 1
            End If
            GoTo ContinueLoop
        End If

        If ch = "|" Then
            nextCh = ""
            If i < Len(abc) Then nextCh = Mid$(abc, i + 1, 1)

            If nextCh = ":" Then
                AddToken tokens, "repeat_start", "|:"
                i = i + 2
            ElseIf nextCh = "1" Then
                ' Alternate ending marker in |1 form
                AddToken tokens, "ending1", "|1"
                i = i + 2
            ElseIf nextCh = "2" Then
                ' Alternate ending marker in |2 form
                AddToken tokens, "ending2", "|2"
                i = i + 2
            ElseIf nextCh = "|" Then
                AddToken tokens, "double_bar", "||"
                i = i + 2
            ElseIf nextCh = "]" Then
                AddToken tokens, "end_bar", "|]"
                i = i + 2
            Else
                AddToken tokens, "bar", "|"
                i = i + 1
            End If
            GoTo ContinueLoop
        End If

        If ch = ":" Then
            nextCh = ""
            If i < Len(abc) Then nextCh = Mid$(abc, i + 1, 1)
            If nextCh = "|" Then
                AddToken tokens, "repeat_end", ":|"
                i = i + 2
            Else
                i = i + 1
            End If
            GoTo ContinueLoop
        End If

        If ch = "(" Then
            ' Tuplet marker: (2, (3, (4, etc.
            Dim tupletStart As Long
            tupletStart = i
            i = i + 1
            Do While i <= Len(abc)
                ch = Mid$(abc, i, 1)
                If (ch >= "0" And ch <= "9") Or ch = ":" Then
                    i = i + 1
                Else
                    Exit Do
                End If
            Loop
            AddToken tokens, "tuplet", Mid$(abc, tupletStart, i - tupletStart)
            GoTo ContinueLoop
        End If

        If ch = "[" Then
            nextCh = ""
            If i < Len(abc) Then nextCh = Mid$(abc, i + 1, 1)
            If nextCh = "|" Then
                ' Check for [|: (start bar + repeat start)
                Dim afterBar As String
                afterBar = ""
                If i + 2 <= Len(abc) Then afterBar = Mid$(abc, i + 2, 1)
                If afterBar = ":" Then
                    AddToken tokens, "repeat_start", "[|:"
                    i = i + 3
                Else
                    AddToken tokens, "start_bar", "[|"
                    i = i + 2
                End If
                GoTo ContinueLoop
            ElseIf nextCh = "1" Then
                AddToken tokens, "ending1", "[1"
                i = i + 2
                GoTo ContinueLoop
            ElseIf nextCh = "2" Then
                AddToken tokens, "ending2", "[2"
                i = i + 2
                GoTo ContinueLoop
            ElseIf nextCh = "[" Then
                ' Double bracket - variant ending marker like [[1
                i = i + 1
                GoTo ContinueLoop
            End If
        End If

        If ch = "]" Then
            nextCh = ""
            If i < Len(abc) Then nextCh = Mid$(abc, i + 1, 1)
            If nextCh = "|" Then
                AddToken tokens, "end_bar", "]|"
                i = i + 2
                GoTo ContinueLoop
            ElseIf nextCh = "]" Then
                ' Close variant ending
                i = i + 2
                GoTo ContinueLoop
            End If
            i = i + 1
            GoTo ContinueLoop
        End If

        If ch = ")" Then
            ' End of tuplet (though ABC often doesn't use explicit end)
            AddToken tokens, "tuplet_end", ")"
            i = i + 1
            GoTo ContinueLoop
        End If

        If (ch >= "A" And ch <= "Z") Or (ch >= "a" And ch <= "z") Then
            Dim startPos As Long
            startPos = i
            i = i + 1
            Do While i <= Len(abc)
                ch = Mid$(abc, i, 1)
                If (ch >= "0" And ch <= "9") Or ch = "/" Or ch = ">" Or ch = "<" Or ch = "-" Then
                    i = i + 1
                Else
                    Exit Do
                End If
            Loop
            AddToken tokens, "note", Mid$(abc, startPos, i - startPos)
            GoTo ContinueLoop
        End If

        i = i + 1

ContinueLoop:
    Loop

    Set TokenizeABC = tokens
End Function

Private Sub AddToken(ByRef tokens As Collection, ByVal tokenType As String, ByVal text As String)
    Dim t(1 To 2) As Variant
    t(1) = tokenType
    t(2) = text
    tokens.Add t
End Sub

' ============================================================
' REPEAT EXPANSION
' ============================================================

Private Function ExpandRepeats(ByVal tokens As Collection) As Collection
    Dim flat As New Collection
    Dim i As Long
    Dim j As Long
    Dim k As Long

    Dim inRepeat As Boolean
    Dim repeatBuffer As New Collection
    Dim ending1Buffer As New Collection
    Dim ending2Buffer As New Collection
    Dim repeatMode As String
    Dim pendingSecondEnding As Boolean
    Dim hasEndings As Boolean

    For i = 1 To tokens.Count
        Dim t As Variant
        t = tokens(i)

        Select Case t(1)
            Case "repeat_start"
                Set repeatBuffer = New Collection
                Set ending1Buffer = New Collection
                Set ending2Buffer = New Collection
                inRepeat = True
                repeatMode = "main"
                pendingSecondEnding = False
                hasEndings = False

            Case "ending1"
                If inRepeat Then
                    repeatMode = "end1"
                    hasEndings = True
                ElseIf pendingSecondEnding Then
                    repeatMode = "end2"
                End If

            Case "ending2"
                If pendingSecondEnding Then
                    repeatMode = "end2"
                End If

            Case "repeat_end"
                If inRepeat Then
                    Dim barToken(1 To 2) As Variant
                    ' Synthetic seam bar from repeat expansion: treat as a section boundary
                    ' for downstream measure validation so pickup-style joins do not false-warn.
                    barToken(1) = "double_bar"
                    barToken(2) = "|"
                    
                    If hasEndings Then
                        ' With endings: add main + first ending, then wait for second ending
                        For j = 1 To repeatBuffer.Count
                            flat.Add repeatBuffer(j)
                        Next j
                        For j = 1 To ending1Buffer.Count
                            flat.Add ending1Buffer(j)
                        Next j
                        flat.Add barToken
                        
                        pendingSecondEnding = True
                        repeatMode = "end2"
                    Else
                        ' Simple repeat: add buffer twice with bar in between
                        For k = 1 To repeatBuffer.Count
                            flat.Add repeatBuffer(k)
                        Next k
                        flat.Add barToken
                        For k = 1 To repeatBuffer.Count
                            flat.Add repeatBuffer(k)
                        Next k
                        flat.Add barToken
                    End If
                    
                    inRepeat = False
                End If

            Case Else
                If inRepeat Then
                    Select Case repeatMode
                        Case "end1"
                            ending1Buffer.Add t
                        Case Else
                            repeatBuffer.Add t
                    End Select
                ElseIf pendingSecondEnding Then
                    If repeatMode = "end2" Then
                        ending2Buffer.Add t
                        ' Finalize second pass only at a strong close (double_bar or end_bar).
                        ' Plain bar is NOT a flush trigger — the second ending may span multiple measures.
                        If t(1) = "double_bar" Or t(1) = "end_bar" Then
                            For k = 1 To repeatBuffer.Count
                                flat.Add repeatBuffer(k)
                            Next k
                            For k = 1 To ending2Buffer.Count
                                flat.Add ending2Buffer(k)
                            Next k
                            pendingSecondEnding = False
                            repeatMode = "main"
                        End If
                    End If
                Else
                    flat.Add t
                End If
        End Select
    Next i

    ' Safety flush: if the piece ended inside a second ending (e.g. no |] barline),
    ' emit whatever was collected.
    If pendingSecondEnding And repeatMode = "end2" And ending2Buffer.Count > 0 Then
        For k = 1 To repeatBuffer.Count
            flat.Add repeatBuffer(k)
        Next k
        For k = 1 To ending2Buffer.Count
            flat.Add ending2Buffer(k)
        Next k
    End If

    Set ExpandRepeats = flat
End Function

' ============================================================
' DURATION PARSING
' ============================================================

Private Function GetNoteDurationUnits(ByVal tokenText As String) As Double
    Dim baseDur As Double
    baseDur = 1#

    Dim i As Long
    i = 2

    Dim numPart As String, denPart As String
    Dim ch As String

    Do While i <= Len(tokenText)
        ch = Mid$(tokenText, i, 1)
        If ch >= "0" And ch <= "9" Then
            numPart = numPart & ch
        ElseIf ch = "/" Then
            i = i + 1
            Do While i <= Len(tokenText)
                ch = Mid$(tokenText, i, 1)
                If ch >= "0" And ch <= "9" Then
                    denPart = denPart & ch
                    i = i + 1
                Else
                    Exit Do
                End If
            Loop
            Exit Do
        Else
            Exit Do
        End If
        i = i + 1
    Loop

    If numPart <> "" And denPart = "" Then
        baseDur = CDbl(numPart)
    ElseIf numPart = "" And denPart <> "" Then
        baseDur = 1# / CDbl(denPart)
    ElseIf numPart <> "" And denPart <> "" Then
        baseDur = CDbl(numPart) / CDbl(denPart)
    End If

    GetNoteDurationUnits = baseDur
End Function

Private Function GetNoteLetterOnly(ByVal tokenText As String) As String
    GetNoteLetterOnly = Left$(tokenText, 1)
End Function

Private Function HasTieForward(ByVal tokenText As String) As Boolean
    Dim s As String
    s = Trim$(tokenText)
    If Len(s) = 0 Then
        HasTieForward = False
    Else
        HasTieForward = (Right$(s, 1) = "-")
    End If
End Function

Private Function StripTieMarker(ByVal tokenText As String) As String
    Dim s As String
    s = Trim$(tokenText)

    Do While Len(s) > 0 And Right$(s, 1) = "-"
        s = Left$(s, Len(s) - 1)
    Loop

    StripTieMarker = s
End Function

Private Function HasBrokenGreater(ByVal tokenText As String) As Boolean
    HasBrokenGreater = (InStr(1, tokenText, ">", vbBinaryCompare) > 0)
End Function

Private Function HasBrokenLess(ByVal tokenText As String) As Boolean
    HasBrokenLess = (InStr(1, tokenText, "<", vbBinaryCompare) > 0)
End Function

' ============================================================
' WRITE EVENTS (FIRST PASS)
' ============================================================

Private Sub WriteEventsFromTokens(ws As Worksheet, ByVal tokens As Collection)
    Dim totalUnits As Double
    totalUnits = 0#

    Dim currentPart As Long
    currentPart = 1

    Dim currentRow As Long
    currentRow = IIf(AppendStartRow > 0, AppendStartRow, FIRST_DATA_ROW)

    Dim voiceLabel As String
    voiceLabel = IIf(ActiveVoice <> "", ActiveVoice, "pipes")

    ' Tuplet tracking
    Dim inTuplet As Boolean
    inTuplet = False
    Dim tupletRatio As Double
    tupletRatio = 1#
    Dim tupletNotesRemaining As Long
    tupletNotesRemaining = 0

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To tokens.Count
        Dim t As Variant
        t = tokens(i)

        Select Case t(1)

            Case "tuplet"
                ' Parse tuplet marker: (3, (2, (4, (3:2, etc.
                Dim tupletStr As String
                tupletStr = t(2)
                Dim tupletN As Long
                tupletN = CLng(Mid$(tupletStr, 2, 1))  ' Get first digit after (
                inTuplet = True
                tupletNotesRemaining = tupletN
                ' (n means "n notes in the time of n-1" (or of 2 for n=3)
                ' For (3: 3 notes in time of 2 -> ratio = 2/3
                ' For (2: 2 notes in time of 3 -> ratio = 3/2
                Select Case tupletN
                    Case 2
                        tupletRatio = 1.5  ' 3/2
                    Case 3
                        tupletRatio = 0.666666667  ' 2/3
                    Case 4
                        tupletRatio = 0.75  ' 3/4
                    Case Else
                        tupletRatio = CDbl(tupletN - 1) / CDbl(tupletN)
                End Select

            Case "tuplet_end"
                inTuplet = False
                tupletRatio = 1#
                tupletNotesRemaining = 0

            Case "bar", "double_bar", "end_bar", "start_bar"
                WriteBarRow ws, currentRow, currentPart, totalUnits
                currentRow = currentRow + 1
                ' Bar line also ends tuplet implicitly
                inTuplet = False
                tupletRatio = 1#
                tupletNotesRemaining = 0

            Case "embellishment"
                WriteEmbellishmentRow ws, currentRow, currentPart, totalUnits, t(2), voiceLabel
                currentRow = currentRow + 1

            Case "note"
                Dim noteText As String
                noteText = t(2)

                Dim cleanNoteText As String
                cleanNoteText = StripTieMarker(noteText)

                Dim baseDur As Double
                baseDur = GetNoteDurationUnits(cleanNoteText)
                
                ' Apply tuplet ratio if we're in a tuplet
                If inTuplet Then
                    baseDur = baseDur * tupletRatio
                    tupletNotesRemaining = tupletNotesRemaining - 1
                    If tupletNotesRemaining <= 0 Then
                        inTuplet = False
                        tupletRatio = 1#
                    End If
                End If

                If HasTieForward(noteText) Then
                    Dim tieLetter As String
                    tieLetter = GetNoteLetterOnly(cleanNoteText)

                    Dim mergedDur As Double
                    mergedDur = baseDur

                    Dim tieContinues As Boolean
                    tieContinues = HasTieForward(noteText)

                    Do While tieContinues
                        If i >= tokens.Count Then Exit Do

                        Dim tieNext As Variant
                        tieNext = tokens(i + 1)
                        If CStr(tieNext(1)) <> "note" Then Exit Do

                        Dim tieNextRaw As String
                        tieNextRaw = CStr(tieNext(2))
                        Dim tieNextClean As String
                        tieNextClean = StripTieMarker(tieNextRaw)

                        If GetNoteLetterOnly(tieNextClean) <> tieLetter Then Exit Do

                        Dim tieNextDur As Double
                        tieNextDur = GetNoteDurationUnits(tieNextClean)

                        If inTuplet Then
                            tieNextDur = tieNextDur * tupletRatio
                            tupletNotesRemaining = tupletNotesRemaining - 1
                            If tupletNotesRemaining <= 0 Then
                                inTuplet = False
                                tupletRatio = 1#
                            End If
                        End If

                        mergedDur = mergedDur + tieNextDur
                        i = i + 1
                        tieContinues = HasTieForward(tieNextRaw)
                    Loop

                    WriteNoteRow ws, currentRow, currentPart, totalUnits, cleanNoteText, mergedDur, , voiceLabel
                    totalUnits = totalUnits + mergedDur
                    currentRow = currentRow + 1
                    GoTo NextToken
                End If

                Dim dur1 As Double, dur2 As Double

                If HasBrokenGreater(cleanNoteText) Or HasBrokenLess(cleanNoteText) Then
                    Dim nextT As Variant
                    If i < tokens.Count Then nextT = tokens(i + 1)

                    If i < tokens.Count And nextT(1) = "note" Then
                        If HasBrokenGreater(cleanNoteText) Then
                            dur1 = baseDur * 1.5
                            dur2 = baseDur * 0.5
                        Else
                            dur1 = baseDur * 0.5
                            dur2 = baseDur * 1.5
                        End If

                        Dim clean1 As String
                        clean1 = Replace(Replace(cleanNoteText, ">", ""), "<", "")

                        Dim brokenDir As String
                        If HasBrokenGreater(cleanNoteText) Then
                            brokenDir = "dotcut"
                        Else
                            brokenDir = "cutdot"
                        End If

                        WriteNoteRow ws, currentRow, currentPart, totalUnits, clean1, dur1, brokenDir, voiceLabel
                        totalUnits = totalUnits + dur1
                        currentRow = currentRow + 1

                        Dim clean2 As String
                        clean2 = StripTieMarker(Replace(Replace(nextT(2), ">", ""), "<", ""))
                        
                        ' Second note of broken rhythm also counts toward tuplet
                        Dim dur2Base As Double
                        dur2Base = GetNoteDurationUnits(clean2)
                        If inTuplet Then
                            dur2Base = dur2Base * tupletRatio
                            tupletNotesRemaining = tupletNotesRemaining - 1
                            If tupletNotesRemaining <= 0 Then
                                inTuplet = False
                                tupletRatio = 1#
                            End If
                        End If
                        ' Recalculate dur2 with broken rhythm applied to potentially-tuplet-adjusted base
                        If HasBrokenGreater(cleanNoteText) Then
                            dur2 = dur2Base * 0.5
                        Else
                            dur2 = dur2Base * 1.5
                        End If

                        WriteNoteRow ws, currentRow, currentPart, totalUnits, clean2, dur2, , voiceLabel
                        totalUnits = totalUnits + dur2
                        currentRow = currentRow + 1

                        i = i + 1
                    Else
                        WriteNoteRow ws, currentRow, currentPart, totalUnits, cleanNoteText, baseDur, , voiceLabel
                        totalUnits = totalUnits + baseDur
                        currentRow = currentRow + 1
                    End If
                Else
                    WriteNoteRow ws, currentRow, currentPart, totalUnits, cleanNoteText, baseDur, , voiceLabel
                    totalUnits = totalUnits + baseDur
                    currentRow = currentRow + 1
                End If

NextToken:

        End Select
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub WriteBarRow(ws As Worksheet, ByVal rowIndex As Long, ByVal part As Long, ByVal totalUnits As Double)
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EVENT_ID).Value = rowIndex - FIRST_DATA_ROW + 1
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TYPE).Value = "structure"
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_STRUCTURE).Value = "bar"

    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_PART).Value = part
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_VOICE).Value = ""
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TOTAL_UNITS).Value = SanitizeNumber(totalUnits)
End Sub

Private Sub WriteEmbellishmentRow(ws As Worksheet, ByVal rowIndex As Long, ByVal part As Long, ByVal totalUnits As Double, ByVal embText As String, Optional ByVal voice As String = "pipes")
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EVENT_ID).Value = rowIndex - FIRST_DATA_ROW + 1
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TYPE).Value = "embellishment"

    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_PART).Value = part
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_VOICE).Value = voice
    
    ' Store literal ABC sequence
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_LITERAL).Value = embText
    
    ' Find preceding note (look backwards for last "note" type row)
    Dim precedingNote As String
    precedingNote = FindPrecedingNote(ws, rowIndex)
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_PRECEDING).Value = precedingNote
    
    ' Target note will be populated in a second pass after all events are written

    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_WRITTEN_UNITS).Value = 0#
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_ADJUSTED_UNITS).Value = 0#
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TOTAL_UNITS).Value = SanitizeNumber(totalUnits)
End Sub

Private Sub WriteNoteRow(ws As Worksheet, ByVal rowIndex As Long, ByVal part As Long, ByVal totalUnits As Double, ByVal noteText As String, ByVal durUnits As Double, Optional ByVal brokenDir As String = "", Optional ByVal voice As String = "pipes")
    Dim noteLetter As String
    noteLetter = GetNoteLetterOnly(noteText)

    If LCase$(noteLetter) = "z" Then
        noteLetter = ""
    End If

    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EVENT_ID).Value = rowIndex - FIRST_DATA_ROW + 1
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TYPE).Value = "note"

    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_PART).Value = part
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_VOICE).Value = voice
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_NOTE_LETTER).Value = noteLetter

    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_WRITTEN_UNITS).Value = SanitizeNumber(durUnits)
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_ADJUSTED_UNITS).Value = SanitizeNumber(durUnits)
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TOTAL_UNITS).Value = SanitizeNumber(totalUnits)

    ' Store broken rhythm marker for notes (used by swing processing)
    ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_BROKEN_DIR).Value = brokenDir
End Sub

Private Function FindPrecedingNote(ws As Worksheet, ByVal currentRow As Long) As String
    Dim r As Long
    For r = currentRow - 1 To FIRST_DATA_ROW Step -1
        If ws.Cells(r, COL_TYPE).Value = "note" And Trim$(ws.Cells(r, COL_NOTE_LETTER).Value & "") <> "" Then
            FindPrecedingNote = ws.Cells(r, COL_NOTE_LETTER).Value
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next r
    FindPrecedingNote = "" ' No preceding note found
End Function

Private Function FindTargetNote(ws As Worksheet, ByVal currentRow As Long) As String
    Dim lastRow As Long
