    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, COL_EVENT_ID).End(xlUp).Row
    
    Dim r As Long
    For r = currentRow + 1 To lastRow
        If ws.Cells(r, COL_TYPE).Value = "note" And Trim$(ws.Cells(r, COL_NOTE_LETTER).Value & "") <> "" Then
            FindTargetNote = ws.Cells(r, COL_NOTE_LETTER).Value
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next r
    FindTargetNote = "" ' No target note found
End Function

Private Sub PopulateEmbellishmentTargets(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim rowIndex As Long
    rowIndex = FIRST_DATA_ROW
    
    Do While ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EVENT_ID).Value <> ""
        If ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TYPE).Value = "embellishment" Then
            ' Find next note
            Dim targetNote As String
            targetNote = FindTargetNote(ws, rowIndex)
            ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_TARGET).Value = targetNote
        End If
        rowIndex = rowIndex + 1
    Loop
End Sub

' ============================================================
' SECOND PASS: POSITION CALCULATION
' ============================================================

Private Sub RecalculatePositions(ws As Worksheet)
    BuildBarPhaseMap ws

    Dim rowIndex As Long
    rowIndex = FIRST_DATA_ROW

    Do While ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EVENT_ID).Value <> ""
        Dim totalUnits As Double
        totalUnits = ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TOTAL_UNITS).Value

        Dim measure As Long, beat As Long
        Dim division As Double

        GetPositionFromUnits totalUnits, measure, beat, division

        ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_MEASURE).Value = measure
        ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_BEAT).Value = beat
        ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_DIVISION).Value = SanitizeNumber(division)

        rowIndex = rowIndex + 1
    Loop
End Sub

Private Sub GetPositionFromUnits(ByVal totalUnits As Double, _
                                 ByRef measure As Long, _
                                 ByRef beat As Long, _
                                 ByRef division As Double)

    ' Use downbeat anchor bars when available. This supports both
    ' initial pickups and internal pickups (e.g., ||e| section joins).
    If DownbeatBarCount > 0 Then
        If totalUnits < DownbeatBarUnits(1) - EPSILON Then
            measure = 0

            Dim unitsIntoPickup As Double
            unitsIntoPickup = totalUnits

            beat = Fix(unitsIntoPickup / UnitsPerBeat) + 1

            Dim unitsIntoPickupBeat As Double
            unitsIntoPickupBeat = unitsIntoPickup - (beat - 1) * UnitsPerBeat
            division = unitsIntoPickupBeat / UnitsPerBeat
            Exit Sub
        End If

        Dim anchorIdx As Long
        anchorIdx = 1

        Dim i As Long
        For i = 2 To DownbeatBarCount
            If totalUnits >= DownbeatBarUnits(i) - EPSILON Then
                anchorIdx = i
            Else
                Exit For
            End If
        Next i

        measure = anchorIdx

        Dim unitsIntoMeasure As Double
        unitsIntoMeasure = totalUnits - DownbeatBarUnits(anchorIdx)
        If unitsIntoMeasure < 0 Then unitsIntoMeasure = 0

        beat = Fix(unitsIntoMeasure / UnitsPerBeat) + 1

        Dim unitsIntoBeat2 As Double
        unitsIntoBeat2 = unitsIntoMeasure - (beat - 1) * UnitsPerBeat
        division = unitsIntoBeat2 / UnitsPerBeat
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Fallback when no bars are available.
    measure = Fix(totalUnits / UnitsPerMeasure) + 1
    Dim unitsIntoMeasureFallback As Double
    unitsIntoMeasureFallback = totalUnits - (measure - 1) * UnitsPerMeasure
    beat = Fix(unitsIntoMeasureFallback / UnitsPerBeat) + 1
    Dim unitsIntoBeatFallback As Double
    unitsIntoBeatFallback = unitsIntoMeasureFallback - (beat - 1) * UnitsPerBeat
    division = unitsIntoBeatFallback / UnitsPerBeat
End Sub

'============================================================
'METADATA PARSING
'============================================================

Private Sub ParseABCMetadata(ws As Worksheet, ByVal metadataText As String)
    Dim lines() As String
    lines = Split(metadataText, vbLf)
    
    Dim i As Long
    Dim line As String
    Dim key As String, Value As String

    ' Clear only fields sourced from ABC headers.
    ' Preserve manually-entered fields (e.g. transition cut-beat metadata).
    ClearABCHeaderMappedMetadata ws
    
    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)
        line = Trim(lines(i))
        If line = "" Then GoTo SkipLine ' Skip blank lines
        
        ' Check if line matches metadata header pattern: single letter + colon
        If Len(line) >= 2 And Mid(line, 2, 1) = ":" Then
            key = UCase(Left(line, 1))
            Value = Trim(Mid(line, 3))
            
            Select Case key
                Case "X" ' Reference number
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "reference number", Value
                Case "T" ' Title
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "title", Value
                Case "A" ' Area
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "area", Value
                Case "B" ' Book
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "book", Value
                Case "C" ' Composer
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "composer", Value
                Case "D" ' Discography
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "discography", Value
                Case "F" ' File name
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "file_name", Value
                Case "G" ' Group
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "group", Value
                Case "H" ' History
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "history", Value
                Case "I" ' Information
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "information", Value
                Case "R" ' Rhythm
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "rhythm", Value
                Case "M" ' Meter
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "meter", Value
                    ParseMeterToTimeSig ws, Value
                Case "L" ' Unit note length
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "unit_note_length", Value
                Case "Q" ' Tempo default
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "tempo_default", Value
                Case "K" ' Key
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "key", Value
                Case "N" ' Notes / info
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "notes", Value
                Case "Z" ' Transcription note
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "transcription_note", Value
                Case "P" ' Parts (if present)
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "parts", Value
                Case "O" ' Origin
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "origin", Value
                Case "S" ' Source
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "source", Value
                Case "W" ' Words
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "words", Value
                Case "U" ' User-defined
                    WriteMetadataValue ws, "user_defined", Value
                Case Else
                    ' Ignore unknown keys or add more mappings if needed
            End Select
        End If
SkipLine:
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub ClearABCHeaderMappedMetadata(ws As Worksheet)
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "reference number", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "title", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "area", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "book", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "composer", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "discography", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "file_name", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "group", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "history", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "information", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "rhythm", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "meter", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "time_sig_num", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "time_sig_den", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "unit_note_length", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "tempo_default", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "key", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "notes", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "transcription_note", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "parts", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "origin", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "source", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "words", ""
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "user_defined", ""
End Sub

Private Sub WriteMetadataValue(ws As Worksheet, ByVal variableName As String, ByVal Value As String)
    Dim r As Long
    For r = 2 To 48
        If LCase(Trim(ws.Cells(r, 2).Value)) = LCase(variableName) Then
            ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = Value
            Exit For
        End If
    Next r
End Sub

Private Sub ParseMeterToTimeSig(ws As Worksheet, ByVal meter As String)
    ' Handle special meter symbols
    If meter = "C" Then
        WriteMetadataValue ws, "time_sig_num", "4"
        WriteMetadataValue ws, "time_sig_den", "4"
        Exit Sub
    ElseIf meter = "C|" Then
        WriteMetadataValue ws, "time_sig_num", "2"
        WriteMetadataValue ws, "time_sig_den", "2"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Dim parts() As String
    parts = Split(meter, "/")
    If UBound(parts) = 1 Then
        WriteMetadataValue ws, "time_sig_num", Trim(parts(0))
        WriteMetadataValue ws, "time_sig_den", Trim(parts(1))
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub InferStructuralMetadata(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, COL_EVENT_ID).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < FIRST_DATA_ROW Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim partsDict As Object
    Set partsDict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    Dim maxMeasure As Long
    maxMeasure = 0
    
    Dim r As Long
    For r = FIRST_DATA_ROW To lastRow
        Dim partVal As Variant
        Dim measureVal As Variant

        ' Ignore structure rows so terminal bar-only measure does not inflate totals.
        If LCase$(Trim$(ws.Cells(r, COL_TYPE).Value)) = "structure" Then GoTo NextRowInfer
        
        partVal = ws.Cells(r, COL_PART).Value
        measureVal = ws.Cells(r, COL_MEASURE).Value

        If Not IsNumeric(measureVal) Then GoTo NextRowInfer

        Dim measureNum As Long
        measureNum = CLng(measureVal)

        ' Exclude pickup bucket from structural metadata counts.
        If measureNum <= 0 Then GoTo NextRowInfer

        If Trim$(partVal & "") = "" Then partVal = 1
        
        If Not partsDict.Exists(partVal) Then
            partsDict.Add partVal, CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        End If
        
        If Not partsDict(partVal).Exists(measureNum) Then
            partsDict(partVal).Add measureNum, True
        End If
        
        If measureNum > maxMeasure Then maxMeasure = measureNum

    NextRowInfer:
    Next r
    
    ' Number of parts
    Dim numParts As Long
    numParts = partsDict.Count
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "parts", CStr(numParts)
    
    ' Total measures
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "measures_total", CStr(maxMeasure)
    
    ' Measures per part (average)
    Dim totalMeasures As Long
    totalMeasures = 0
    Dim key As Variant
    For Each key In partsDict.Keys
        totalMeasures = totalMeasures + partsDict(key).Count
    Next key
    
    Dim avgMeasuresPerPart As Double
    If numParts > 0 Then
        avgMeasuresPerPart = totalMeasures / numParts
    Else
        avgMeasuresPerPart = 0
    End If
    
    WriteMetadataValue ws, "measures_per_part", Format(avgMeasuresPerPart, "0.00")
End Sub

' ============================================================
' HELPERS
' ============================================================

Private Function SanitizeNumber(ByVal v As Double) As Double
    If Abs(v) < EPSILON Then
        SanitizeNumber = 0#
    Else
        SanitizeNumber = Round(v, ROUND_DECIMALS)
    End If
End Function

Private Function NzNum(v As Variant) As String
    If Trim$(v & "") = "" Then
        NzNum = "0"
    Else
        NzNum = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function NzStr(v As Variant) As String
    If Trim$(v & "") = "" Then
        NzStr = ""
    Else
        NzStr = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function TrimComma(s As String) As String
    If Right$(s, 1) = "," Then
        TrimComma = Left$(s, Len(s) - 1)
    Else
        TrimComma = s
    End If
End Function

Private Function EscapeJSON(s As String) As String
    s = Replace(s, "\", "\\")
    s = Replace(s, """", "\""")
    EscapeJSON = s
End Function

Private Function FormatJSONNumber(ByVal v As Double) As String
    ' Formats a Double as a valid JSON number (dot decimal, no trailing dot, no locale comma).
    Dim s As String
    s = CStr(v)                          ' VBA CStr uses current locale
    s = Replace(s, ",", ".")             ' normalise locale decimal separator to dot
    ' If the string ends with a dot, append a zero
    If Right$(s, 1) = "." Then s = s & "0"
    FormatJSONNumber = s
End Function

' ============================================================
' ABC FILE HELPERS
' ============================================================
' Assembles the complete ABC text from the parts table (col I, rows 2-25).
' The metadata row (Type="metadata") provides the header block; all other
' non-empty rows are appended as body in table order.
Private Function BuildFullABC(ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim header As String
    Dim body   As String
    Dim r      As Long
    Dim isTransitionTune As Boolean
    header = ""
    body   = ""

    isTransitionTune = (LCase$(Trim$(CStr(GetMetadataValue(ws, "rhythm")))) = "transition")

    For r = PART_TABLE_FIRST_ROW To PART_TABLE_MAX_ROW
        Dim partType As String
        Dim abcText  As String
        Dim tailText As String
        Dim headText As String
        partType = LCase$(Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_TYPE_COL).Value))
        abcText  = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_ABC_COL).Value)
        tailText = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_TAIL_COL).Value)
        headText = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_HEAD_COL).Value)
        If partType = "" Then GoTo NextABCRow

        If partType = "metadata" Then
            If abcText <> "" Then header = abcText
        Else
            If isTransitionTune And partType = "melody" Then
                If tailText <> "" Then
                    If body <> "" Then body = body & vbCrLf
                    body = body & tailText
                End If
                If abcText <> "" Then
                    If body <> "" Then body = body & vbCrLf
                    body = body & abcText
                End If
                If headText <> "" Then
                    If body <> "" Then body = body & vbCrLf
                    body = body & headText
                End If
            Else
                If abcText <> "" Then
                    If body <> "" Then body = body & vbCrLf
                    body = body & abcText
                End If
            End If
        End If
NextABCRow:
    Next r

    If header = "" And body = "" Then
        BuildFullABC = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim result As String
    result = header
    If body <> "" Then
        If result <> "" Then result = result & vbCrLf
        result = result & body
    End If
    BuildFullABC = result
End Function

' ============================================================
' JSON EXPORT
' ============================================================
Public Sub ExportEventsToJSON()

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ActiveSheet

    Dim json As String
    Dim metaTune As String, metaMet As String, metaPerf As String, metaInfo As String
    Dim rowIndex As Long

    ' BUILD METADATA BLOCK
    metaTune = ""
    metaMet = ""
    metaPerf = ""
    metaInfo = ""

    ' Metadata rows: 2–48
    For rowIndex = 2 To 48

        Dim category As String
        Dim key As String
        Dim val As String

        category = Trim$(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 1).Value)
        key = Trim$(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 2).Value)
        val = Trim$(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 3).Value)

        If key <> "" Then
            Dim entry As String
            entry = """" & key & """: """ & EscapeJSON(val) & """"

            Select Case LCase$(category)
                Case "tune"
                    metaTune = metaTune & entry & ","
                Case "transition"
                    metaTune = metaTune & entry & ","
                Case "metronome"
                    metaMet = metaMet & entry & ","
                Case "performance"
                    metaPerf = metaPerf & entry & ","
                Case "info"
                    metaInfo = metaInfo & entry & ","
            End Select
        End If
    Next rowIndex

    ' Trim trailing commas
    metaTune = TrimComma(metaTune)
    metaMet = TrimComma(metaMet)
    metaPerf = TrimComma(metaPerf)
    metaInfo = TrimComma(metaInfo)

    ' START JSON OUTPUT
    json = "{"

    ' Place tune metadata at root level — append computed rhythmic/pickup fields
    Dim tuneComma As String
    tuneComma = IIf(metaTune <> "", ",", "")
    json = json & """tune"":{" & metaTune & tuneComma & _
           """has_pickup"":" & IIf(PickupDetected, "true", "false") & _
           ",""pickup_offset_units"":" & FormatJSONNumber(PickupOffsetUnits) & _
           ",""units_per_measure"":" & FormatJSONNumber(UnitsPerMeasure) & _
           ",""beats_per_measure"":" & CStr(BeatsPerMeasure) & _
           ",""measure_count"":" & CStr(DownbeatBarCount) & "},"

    ' Include other metadata categories as nested objects under their keys
    json = json & """metronome"":{" & metaMet & "},"
    json = json & """performance"":{" & metaPerf & "},"
    json = json & """info"":{" & metaInfo & "},"

    json = json & """events"":["

    ' EXPORT EVENTS (starting row 51)
    rowIndex = 51

    Do While ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EVENT_ID).Value <> ""

        Dim obj As String
        obj = "{"

        obj = obj & """event_id"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EVENT_ID).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""type"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TYPE).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""structure"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_STRUCTURE).Value) & """"

        obj = obj & ",""part"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_PART).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""voice"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_VOICE).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""measure"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_MEASURE).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""beat"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_BEAT).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""division"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_DIVISION).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""phrase"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_PHRASE).Value) & """"

        obj = obj & ",""letter"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_NOTE_LETTER).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""midi_value"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_NOTE_MIDI).Value)

        obj = obj & ",""written"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_WRITTEN_UNITS).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""adjusted"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_ADJUSTED_UNITS).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""total_units"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TOTAL_UNITS).Value)

        obj = obj & ",""emb_preceding"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_PRECEDING).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""emb_literal"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_LITERAL).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""emb_target"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_TARGET).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""alt_anchor"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_ALT_ANCHOR).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""alt_timing"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_ALT_TIMING).Value) & """"

        Dim brokenDir As String
        brokenDir = NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_BROKEN_DIR).Value)
        If LCase$(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TYPE).Value) = "note" And brokenDir <> "" Then
            obj = obj & ",""broken_dir"":""" & brokenDir & """"
        End If

        obj = obj & ",""start_time_ms"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_START_MS).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""end_time_ms"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_END_MS).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""tempo"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TEMPO_BPM).Value)

        obj = obj & "}"

        json = json & obj & ","
        rowIndex = rowIndex + 1
    Loop

    ' Trim trailing comma
    If Right$(json, 1) = "," Then json = Left$(json, Len(json) - 1)

    json = json & "]}"

    ' SAVE FILE
    Dim fileName As Variant
    fileName = Application.GetSaveAsFilename("tune.json", "JSON Files (*.json), *.json")

    If fileName <> False Then
        Dim ff As Integer
        ff = FreeFile
        Open CStr(fileName) For Output As #ff
        Print #ff, json
        Close #ff

        ' Write sibling .abc file (same base path, .abc extension)
        Dim abcContent As String
        abcContent = BuildFullABC(ws)
        If abcContent <> "" Then
            Dim abcFile As String
            Dim dotPos As Long
            dotPos = InStrRev(CStr(fileName), ".")
            If dotPos > 0 Then
                abcFile = Left$(CStr(fileName), dotPos - 1) & ".abc"
            Else
                abcFile = CStr(fileName) & ".abc"
            End If
            Dim ff2 As Integer
            ff2 = FreeFile
            Open abcFile For Output As #ff2
            Print #ff2, abcContent
            Close #ff2
            MsgBox "JSON export complete." & vbCrLf & "ABC file written: " & abcFile
        Else
            MsgBox "JSON export complete." & vbCrLf & "(No ABC parts table found — .abc file not written.)"
        End If
    End If

End Sub

' ============================================================
' INFER BROKEN RHYTHM MARKERS FROM DURATION PAIRS
' ============================================================
Public Sub InferBrokenRhythms()
    ' Post-processing macro to detect broken rhythm pairs (3/2 + 1/2 or 1/2 + 3/2)
    ' and populate broken_dir column on the FIRST note of each pair
    ' GameMaker only checks the first note and applies swing to both notes
    
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    
    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, COL_EVENT_ID).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < FIRST_DATA_ROW Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim r As Long
    Dim changedCount As Long
    changedCount = 0
    
    For r = FIRST_DATA_ROW To lastRow - 1
        ' Only check note rows
        If LCase$(ws.Cells(r, COL_TYPE).Value) <> "note" Then GoTo NextRow
        If Trim$(ws.Cells(r, COL_NOTE_LETTER).Value & "") = "" Then GoTo NextRow
        
        ' Skip if already marked (from > < symbols in ABC)
        If ws.Cells(r, COL_BROKEN_DIR).Value <> "" Then GoTo NextRow
        
        ' Find next note (skip embellishments, but stop at bars)
        Dim nextNoteRow As Long
        nextNoteRow = 0
        Dim s As Long
        For s = r + 1 To lastRow
            Dim cellType As String
            cellType = LCase$(ws.Cells(s, COL_TYPE).Value)
            
            If cellType = "structure" And ws.Cells(s, COL_STRUCTURE).Value = "bar" Then
                ' Hit a bar before finding next note - stop searching
                Exit For
            ElseIf cellType = "note" And Trim$(ws.Cells(s, COL_NOTE_LETTER).Value & "") <> "" Then
                nextNoteRow = s
                Exit For
            End If
        Next s
        
        If nextNoteRow = 0 Then GoTo NextRow
        
        ' Get written durations
        Dim dur1 As Double, dur2 As Double
        dur1 = CDbl(ws.Cells(r, COL_WRITTEN_UNITS).Value)
        dur2 = CDbl(ws.Cells(nextNoteRow, COL_WRITTEN_UNITS).Value)
        
        ' Check for 3/2 + 1/2 pattern (dotcut - first note lengthened, second shortened)
        If Abs(dur1 - 1.5) < EPSILON And Abs(dur2 - 0.5) < EPSILON Then
            ws.Cells(r, COL_BROKEN_DIR).Value = "dotcut"
            changedCount = changedCount + 1
            ' Skip the second note of the pair to prevent double-processing
            r = nextNoteRow
        ' Check for 1/2 + 3/2 pattern (cutdot - first note shortened, second lengthened)
        ElseIf Abs(dur1 - 0.5) < EPSILON And Abs(dur2 - 1.5) < EPSILON Then
            ws.Cells(r, COL_BROKEN_DIR).Value = "cutdot"
            changedCount = changedCount + 1
            ' Skip the second note of the pair to prevent double-processing
            r = nextNoteRow
        End If
        
NextRow:
    Next r
    
    MsgBox "Inferred " & changedCount & " broken rhythm marker(s).", vbInformation
End Sub

' ============================================================
' EXPORT EMBELLISHMENT LIBRARY TO JSON
' ============================================================
Public Sub ExportEmbellishmentsToJSON()

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Embellishments")

    Dim json As String
    json = "["

    Dim rowIndex As Long
    rowIndex = 2  ' Skip header row

    Do While ws.Cells(rowIndex, 1).Value <> ""

        Dim obj As String
        obj = "{"

        obj = obj & """emb_id"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 1).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""emb_name"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 2).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""pattern"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 3).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""target_note"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 4).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""notes"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 5).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""timing"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 6).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""anchor_index"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 7).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""category"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 8).Value) & """"

        obj = obj & "}"

        json = json & obj & ","
        rowIndex = rowIndex + 1
    Loop

    ' Trim trailing comma
    If Right$(json, 1) = "," Then json = Left$(json, Len(json) - 1)

    json = json & "]"

    ' Save file
    Dim fileName As Variant
    fileName = Application.GetSaveAsFilename("embellishments.json", "JSON Files (*.json), *.json")

    If fileName <> False Then
        Dim ff As Integer
        ff = FreeFile
        Open CStr(fileName) For Output As #ff
        Print #ff, json
        Close #ff
        MsgBox "Embellishment library export complete."
    End If

End Sub

' ============================================================
' SCORE IMAGE EXPORT
' ============================================================
' Renders per-measure PNGs for a tune using the abc_to_png.js pipeline.
' Requires: Node.js + C:\tools\abc_to_png.js + resvg.exe on PATH.
'
' outputDir: folder to write m001.png, m002.png, etc. into.
'            If empty, prompts for the .abc file and writes a /score/ subfolder.
' abcFilePath: path to the .abc file. If empty, prompts the user.
' imageWidth:  pixel width for each PNG (0 = use default 800).
'
Public Sub ExportMeasureImages(Optional abcFilePath As String = "", _
                               Optional outputDir As String = "", _
                               Optional imageWidth As Long = 0)

    ' ---- Resolve .abc file ----
    Dim abcFile As String
    If abcFilePath <> "" Then
        abcFile = abcFilePath
    Else
        Dim picked As Variant
        picked = Application.GetOpenFilename("ABC Files (*.abc), *.abc", , "Select ABC file to render")
        If picked = False Then Exit Sub
        abcFile = CStr(picked)
    End If

    If Dir(abcFile) = "" Then
        MsgBox "ABC file not found:" & vbCrLf & abcFile, vbExclamation, "Export Error"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' ---- Resolve output dir ----
    Dim outDir As String
    If outputDir <> "" Then
        outDir = outputDir
    Else
        ' Default: /score/ subfolder next to the .abc file
        Dim baseDir As String
        baseDir = Left$(abcFile, InStrRev(abcFile, "\"))
        outDir = baseDir & "score"
    End If

    ' ---- Resolve width ----
    Dim width As Long
    width = IIf(imageWidth > 0, imageWidth, 800)

    ' Clear generated artifacts so stale images do not survive a re-export.
    If Dir(outDir, vbDirectory) = "" Then
        On Error Resume Next
        MkDir outDir
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            MsgBox "Could not create output folder:" & vbCrLf & outDir & vbCrLf & Err.Description, vbExclamation, "Export Error"
            Exit Sub
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
    ClearGeneratedScoreOutputs outDir

    ' Pass current render intent through to abc_to_png.js via a small temp JSON file.
    Dim settingsFile As String
    Dim settingsJson As String
    Dim ffSettings As Integer
    settingsFile = Environ("TEMP") & "\abc_to_png_settings.json"
    settingsJson = "{""image_width"":" & CStr(width) & ",""merge_split_bars"":" & IIf(MergeSplitBarsForScore, "true", "false") & "}"
    On Error Resume Next
    ffSettings = FreeFile
    Open settingsFile For Output As #ffSettings
    Print #ffSettings, settingsJson
    Close #ffSettings
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then settingsFile = ""
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' ---- Locate node.exe ----
    Dim nodePath As String
    nodePath = "C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe"
    If Dir(nodePath) = "" Then
        MsgBox "node.exe not found at:" & vbCrLf & nodePath, vbExclamation, "Export Error"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' ---- Build command ----
    Dim scriptPath As String
    scriptPath = "C:\tools\abc_to_png.js"

    If Dir(scriptPath) = "" Then
        MsgBox "abc_to_png.js not found at:" & vbCrLf & scriptPath & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
               "Copy the script to C:\tools\ and try again.", vbExclamation, "Export Error"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim batFile As String
    batFile = Environ("TEMP") & "\abc_to_png_run.bat"

    ' Write a batch file to avoid cmd /c quoting issues with paths containing spaces
    Dim ffBat As Integer
    ffBat = FreeFile
    Open batFile For Output As #ffBat
    Print #ffBat, "@echo off"
    Print #ffBat, "SET PATH=C:\tools\;" & "%" & "PATH" & "%"
    If settingsFile <> "" Then
        Print #ffBat, """" & nodePath & """ """ & scriptPath & """ """ & abcFile & """ """ & outDir & """ " & width & " """ & settingsFile & """"
    Else
        Print #ffBat, """" & nodePath & """ """ & scriptPath & """ """ & abcFile & """ """ & outDir & """ " & width
    End If
    Close #ffBat

    ' ---- Run ----
    Dim shell As Object
    Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")

    Application.StatusBar = "Rendering score images..."
    Dim exitCode As Long
    exitCode = shell.Run("cmd /c """ & batFile & """", 0, True)
    Application.StatusBar = False

    If exitCode = 0 Then
        Dim manifestFile As String
        manifestFile = outDir & "\score_images.json"
        If Dir(manifestFile) <> "" Then
            MsgBox "Score images rendered successfully." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                   "Output: " & outDir & vbCrLf & _
                   "Manifest: score_images.json", vbInformation, "Export Complete"
        Else
            MsgBox "Render completed (exit 0) but score_images.json not found." & vbCrLf & _
                   "Check: " & outDir, vbExclamation, "Export Warning"
        End If
    Else
        MsgBox "Render failed (exit code " & exitCode & ")." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
               "Check that node.exe is at C:\Program Files\nodejs\" & vbCrLf & _
               "and that C:\tools\abc_to_png.js and resvg.exe exist.", vbCritical, "Export Error"
    End If

End Sub

Private Sub ClearGeneratedScoreOutputs(ByVal outDir As String)
    If Dir(outDir, vbDirectory) = "" Then Exit Sub

    Dim patterns As Variant
    patterns = Array("*.png", "*.svg", "score_images.json")

    Dim i As Long
    For i = LBound(patterns) To UBound(patterns)
        Dim fileName As String
        fileName = Dir(outDir & "\" & CStr(patterns(i)))
        Do While fileName <> ""
            On Error Resume Next
            Kill outDir & "\" & fileName
            On Error GoTo 0
            fileName = Dir()
        Loop
    Next i
End Sub

' ============================================================
' COMBINED EXPORT — JSON + ABC + SCORE IMAGES IN ONE STEP
' ============================================================

' Strips characters invalid in Windows filenames; preserves spaces.
Private Function CleanTuneName(ByVal rawName As String) As String
    Dim result As String
    result = rawName
    Dim invalidChars As String
    invalidChars = "\/:*?""<>|"
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(invalidChars)
        result = Replace(result, Mid$(invalidChars, i, 1), "")
    Next i
    CleanTuneName = Trim$(result)
End Function

Public Sub ExportTuneAll()

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    MergeSplitBarsForScore = ParseMetadataBoolean(GetMetadataValue(ws, "score_merge_split_bars"))

    ' ---- Read tune title from metadata ----
    Dim tuneTitle As String
    tuneTitle = Trim$(CStr(GetMetadataValue(ws, "title")))
    If tuneTitle = "" Then
        MsgBox "No tune title found in metadata table." & vbCrLf & _
               "Set the 'title' variable in the B/C metadata table first.", _
               vbExclamation, "Export Error"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim tuneName As String
    tuneName = CleanTuneName(tuneTitle)
    If tuneName = "" Then
        MsgBox "Could not derive a valid filename from title: " & tuneTitle, _
               vbExclamation, "Export Error"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' ---- Ask user to pick the tunes root folder ----
    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFolderPicker)
    fd.Title = "Select tunes root folder (e.g. datafiles\tunes)"
    fd.InitialFileName = "C:\Users\xian\GameMakerProjects\Silly-Wizard\datafiles\tunes\"
    If fd.Show = False Then Exit Sub

    Dim tunesRoot As String
    tunesRoot = fd.SelectedItems(1)
    If Right$(tunesRoot, 1) <> "\" Then tunesRoot = tunesRoot & "\"

    ' ---- Build paths ----
    Dim tuneDir As String
    tuneDir = tunesRoot & tuneName & "\"
    Dim jsonFile As String
    jsonFile = tuneDir & tuneName & ".json"
    Dim abcFile As String
    abcFile = tuneDir & tuneName & ".abc"
    Dim scoreDir As String
    scoreDir = tuneDir & "score"

    ' ---- Create tune subfolder if needed ----
    If Dir(tuneDir, vbDirectory) = "" Then
        On Error Resume Next
        MkDir tuneDir
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            MsgBox "Could not create folder: " & tuneDir & vbCrLf & Err.Description, _
                   vbExclamation, "Export Error"
            Exit Sub
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If

    ' ---- Step 1: Export JSON ----
    Application.StatusBar = "Step 1/4 - Exporting JSON..."
    Call ExportEventsToJSON_ToFile(ws, jsonFile)

    ' ---- Step 2: Write source ABC ----
    Application.StatusBar = "Step 2/4 - Writing source ABC file..."
    Dim abcContent As String
    abcContent = BuildFullABC(ws)
    If abcContent <> "" Then
        Dim ff As Integer
        ff = FreeFile
        Open abcFile For Output As #ff
        Print #ff, abcContent
        Close #ff
    Else
        MsgBox "No ABC parts table found — skipping .abc and image export.", _
               vbExclamation, "Export Warning"
        Application.StatusBar = False
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' ---- Step 3: Build score snippets JSON (one ABC snippet per game measure) ----
    Application.StatusBar = "Step 3/4 - Building score snippets..."
    Dim scoreSnippetsJSON As String
    scoreSnippetsJSON = BuildScoreSnippetsJSON(ws, abcContent)
    If Trim$(scoreSnippetsJSON) = "" Then
        MsgBox "Could not build score snippets.", vbExclamation, "Export Error"
        Application.StatusBar = False
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim scoreSnippetsFile As String
    scoreSnippetsFile = tuneDir & tuneName & ".score_snippets.json"
    ff = FreeFile
    Open scoreSnippetsFile For Output As #ff
    Print #ff, scoreSnippetsJSON
    Close #ff

    Dim scoreImageWidth As Long
    scoreImageWidth = ResolveScoreExportImageWidth(ws)

    ' ---- Step 4: Render score images from snippets ----
    Application.StatusBar = "Step 4/4 - Rendering score images..."
    Call ExportMeasureImages(scoreSnippetsFile, scoreDir, scoreImageWidth)

    ' ---- Step 4b: Render optional per-part score image bundles ----
    Dim scoreGroupsJSON As String
    scoreGroupsJSON = BuildScoreImageGroupsJSON(ws, abcContent, tuneDir, scoreDir, tuneName, scoreImageWidth)
    If Trim$(scoreGroupsJSON) <> "" Then
        Dim scoreGroupsFile As String
        scoreGroupsFile = tuneDir & tuneName & ".score_groups.json"
        ff = FreeFile
        Open scoreGroupsFile For Output As #ff
        Print #ff, scoreGroupsJSON
        Close #ff
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = False
    MsgBox "All done!" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "JSON:   " & jsonFile & vbCrLf & _
           "ABC:    " & abcFile & vbCrLf & _
           "Snippets: " & scoreSnippetsFile & vbCrLf & _
           "Images: " & scoreDir, vbInformation, "Export Complete"

End Sub

Private Function BuildScoreSnippetsJSON(ws As Worksheet, ByVal fullABC As String) As String
    Dim isTransitionTune As Boolean
    isTransitionTune = (LCase$(Trim$(CStr(GetMetadataValue(ws, "rhythm")))) = "transition")

    If isTransitionTune Then
        BuildScoreSnippetsJSON = BuildTransitionScoreSnippetsJSON(ws, fullABC)
    Else
        BuildScoreSnippetsJSON = BuildSnippetBundleJSON(ExtractABCHeaderBlock(fullABC), ExtractABCBodyBlock(fullABC), "")
    End If
End Function

Private Function BuildScoreImageGroupsJSON(ws As Worksheet, ByVal fullABC As String, ByVal tuneDir As String, ByVal scoreDir As String, ByVal tuneName As String, ByVal imageWidth As Long) As String
    Dim header As String
    header = ExtractABCHeaderBlock(fullABC)

    ' Build per-channel ABC directly from parts-table rows so grouped export
    ' does not depend on V: voice headers being present in the combined ABC.
    Dim bodyPart2 As String
    Dim bodyPart3 As String
    Dim bodyPart4 As String
    Dim bodyPart5 As String
    bodyPart2 = ""
    bodyPart3 = ""
    bodyPart4 = ""
    bodyPart5 = ""

    Dim r As Long
    For r = PART_TABLE_FIRST_ROW To PART_TABLE_MAX_ROW
        Dim partType As String
        Dim abcText As String
        Dim channelFromPart As Long

        partType = LCase$(Trim$(CStr(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_TYPE_COL).Value)))
        channelFromPart = ResolveScoreGroupPartChannel(partType)
        If channelFromPart = 0 Then GoTo NextGroupPartRow

        abcText = Trim$(CStr(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_ABC_COL).Value))
        If abcText = "" Then GoTo NextGroupPartRow

        Select Case channelFromPart
            Case 2
                bodyPart2 = AppendABCBodyLine(bodyPart2, abcText)
            Case 3
                bodyPart3 = AppendABCBodyLine(bodyPart3, abcText)
            Case 4
                bodyPart4 = AppendABCBodyLine(bodyPart4, abcText)
            Case 5
                bodyPart5 = AppendABCBodyLine(bodyPart5, abcText)
        End Select

NextGroupPartRow:
    Next r

    Dim json As String
    Dim firstGroup As Boolean
    json = "{" & vbCrLf
    json = json & "  ""groups"": [" & vbCrLf
    firstGroup = True

    Dim channel As Long
    For channel = 2 To 5
        Dim voiceBody As String
        Select Case channel
            Case 2
                voiceBody = bodyPart2
            Case 3
                voiceBody = bodyPart3
            Case 4
                voiceBody = bodyPart4
            Case 5
                voiceBody = bodyPart5
            Case Else
                voiceBody = ""
        End Select
        If Trim$(voiceBody) = "" Then GoTo NextGroupChannel

        Dim groupName As String
        groupName = "part" & CStr(channel)

        Dim groupSnippetsJSON As String
        groupSnippetsJSON = BuildSnippetBundleJSON(header, voiceBody, groupName)
        If Trim$(groupSnippetsJSON) = "" Then GoTo NextGroupChannel

        Dim groupDir As String
        groupDir = scoreDir & "\" & groupName
        If Dir(groupDir, vbDirectory) = "" Then MkDir groupDir

        Dim groupSnippetsFile As String
        groupSnippetsFile = tuneDir & tuneName & ".score_" & groupName & ".json"
        Dim ff As Integer
        ff = FreeFile
        Open groupSnippetsFile For Output As #ff
        Print #ff, groupSnippetsJSON
        Close #ff

        Call ExportMeasureImages(groupSnippetsFile, groupDir, imageWidth)

        If Not firstGroup Then json = json & "," & vbCrLf
        firstGroup = False
        json = json & "    {" & vbCrLf
        json = json & "      ""group"": """ & EscapeJSON(groupName) & """," & vbCrLf
        json = json & "      ""part_channel"": " & CStr(channel) & "," & vbCrLf
        json = json & "      ""part_label"": ""P" & CStr(channel - 1) & """," & vbCrLf
        json = json & "      ""subdir"": """ & EscapeJSON(groupName) & """" & vbCrLf
        json = json & "    }"

NextGroupChannel:
    Next channel

    json = json & vbCrLf & "  ]" & vbCrLf & "}"
    BuildScoreImageGroupsJSON = json
End Function

Private Function ResolveScoreGroupPartChannel(ByVal partType As String) As Long
    Select Case LCase$(Trim$(partType))
        Case "melody"
            ResolveScoreGroupPartChannel = 0
        Case "harmony1"
            ResolveScoreGroupPartChannel = 3
        Case "harmony2"
            ResolveScoreGroupPartChannel = 4
        Case "harmony3"
            ResolveScoreGroupPartChannel = 5
        Case Else
            ResolveScoreGroupPartChannel = 0
    End Select
End Function

Private Function ABCHasVoiceHeaders(ByVal abcText As String) As Boolean
    Dim normalized As String
    normalized = Replace(abcText, vbCrLf, vbLf)
    normalized = Replace(normalized, vbCr, vbLf)

    Dim lines() As String
    lines = Split(normalized, vbLf)

    Dim i As Long
    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)
        If IsVoiceHeaderLine(lines(i)) Then
            ABCHasVoiceHeaders = True
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i
End Function

Private Function BuildTransitionScoreSnippetsJSON(ws As Worksheet, ByVal fullABC As String) As String
    Dim transitionHeader As String
    transitionHeader = ExtractABCHeaderBlock(fullABC)

    Dim priorRef As String
    Dim followingRef As String
    priorRef = Trim$(CStr(GetMetadataValue(ws, "prior_tune")))
    followingRef = Trim$(CStr(GetMetadataValue(ws, "following_tune")))

    Dim priorHeader As String
    Dim followingHeader As String
    priorHeader = ResolveTransitionReferenceHeader(ws, priorRef, transitionHeader)
    followingHeader = ResolveTransitionReferenceHeader(ws, followingRef, transitionHeader)

    Dim tailBody As String
    Dim bridgeBody As String
    Dim headBody As String
    tailBody = ""
    bridgeBody = ""
    headBody = ""

    Dim r As Long
    For r = PART_TABLE_FIRST_ROW To PART_TABLE_MAX_ROW
        Dim partType As String
        Dim abcText As String
        Dim tailText As String
        Dim headText As String

        partType = LCase$(Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_TYPE_COL).Value))
        If partType = "" Or partType = "metadata" Then GoTo NextTransitionSegmentRow

        abcText = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_ABC_COL).Value)
        tailText = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_TAIL_COL).Value)
        headText = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_HEAD_COL).Value)

        If tailText <> "" Then tailBody = AppendABCBodyLine(tailBody, tailText)
        If abcText <> "" Then bridgeBody = AppendABCBodyLine(bridgeBody, abcText)
        If headText <> "" Then headBody = AppendABCBodyLine(headBody, headText)

NextTransitionSegmentRow:
    Next r

    Dim priorJSON As String
    Dim bridgeJSON As String
    Dim followJSON As String
    priorJSON = BuildSnippetBundleJSON(priorHeader, tailBody, "prior_replace")
    bridgeJSON = BuildSnippetBundleJSON(transitionHeader, bridgeBody, "bridge")
    followJSON = BuildSnippetBundleJSON(followingHeader, headBody, "follow_replace")

    Dim tuneName As String
    tuneName = CStr(GetMetadataValue(ws, "title"))

    Dim json As String
    Dim firstGroup As Boolean
    json = "{" & vbCrLf
    json = json & "  ""tune"": """ & EscapeJSON(tuneName) & """," & vbCrLf
    json = json & "  ""score_manifest_version"": 3," & vbCrLf
    json = json & "  ""is_transition"": true," & vbCrLf
    json = json & "  ""transition_refs"": {" & vbCrLf
    json = json & "    ""prior_tune"": """ & EscapeJSON(priorRef) & """," & vbCrLf
    json = json & "    ""following_tune"": """ & EscapeJSON(followingRef) & """," & vbCrLf
    json = json & "    ""tail_cut_measures"": """ & EscapeJSON(CStr(GetMetadataValue(ws, "tail_cut_measures"))) & """," & vbCrLf
    json = json & "    ""head_cut_measures"": """ & EscapeJSON(CStr(GetMetadataValue(ws, "head_cut_measures"))) & """" & vbCrLf
    json = json & "  }," & vbCrLf
    json = json & "  ""transition_score"": {" & vbCrLf

    firstGroup = True
    If Trim$(priorJSON) <> "" Then
        json = json & "    ""prior_replace"": " & priorJSON
        firstGroup = False
    End If
    If Trim$(bridgeJSON) <> "" Then
        If Not firstGroup Then json = json & "," & vbCrLf
        json = json & "    ""bridge"": " & bridgeJSON
        firstGroup = False
    End If
    If Trim$(followJSON) <> "" Then
        If Not firstGroup Then json = json & "," & vbCrLf
        json = json & "    ""follow_replace"": " & followJSON
    End If

    json = json & vbCrLf & "  }" & vbCrLf & "}"
    BuildTransitionScoreSnippetsJSON = json
End Function

Private Function BuildSnippetBundleJSON(ByVal header As String, ByVal bodyABC As String, Optional ByVal groupName As String = "") As String
    ' Builds one snippet bundle: one ABC body snippet per game measure.
    ' Game measures are delimited by accumulated note units reaching UnitsPerMeasure,
    ' which matches the same boundary logic as the event-grid measure numbers.
    ' ABC barlines that fall mid-game-measure (split-bar joins) are silently dropped
    ' from the snippet body so each image renders as a clean single bar.

    Dim fullABC As String
    header = Trim$(header)
    bodyABC = Trim$(bodyABC)
    If groupName <> "" Then
        bodyABC = NormalizeStandaloneTransitionABC(bodyABC)
    End If
    If bodyABC = "" Then
        BuildSnippetBundleJSON = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    fullABC = bodyABC
    If header <> "" Then fullABC = header & vbCrLf & bodyABC

    CalculateRhythmicConstantsFromABCHeader header

    Dim bodyPrepared As String
    bodyPrepared = PrepareABCForVoice(fullABC, "")
    If Trim$(bodyPrepared) = "" Then
        BuildSnippetBundleJSON = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim tokens As Collection
    Set tokens = TokenizeABC(bodyPrepared)

    Dim flatTokens As Collection
    Set flatTokens = ExpandRepeats(tokens)

    ' Split flat token stream into per-game-measure snippet bodies
    Dim snippetBodies() As String
    Dim snippetUnits() As Double
    Dim snippetCount As Long
    ReDim snippetBodies(0 To flatTokens.Count)   ' upper bound generous
    ReDim snippetUnits(0 To flatTokens.Count)
    snippetCount = 0

    Dim currentBody As String
    Dim currentMeasureUnits As Double
    Dim tol As Double
    tol = 0.02
    currentBody = ""
    currentMeasureUnits = 0#

    ' Tuplet state mirrors WriteEventsFromTokens so snippet durations
    ' match playback timing math exactly.
    Dim inTuplet As Boolean
    Dim tupletRatio As Double
    Dim tupletRemaining As Long
    inTuplet = False
    tupletRatio = 1#
    tupletRemaining = 0

    Dim i As Long
    i = 1
    Do While i <= flatTokens.Count
        Dim t As Variant
        Dim tokenType As String
        t = flatTokens(i)
        tokenType = CStr(t(1))

        If tokenType = "start_bar" Then
            ' Start-of-tune barline ([| or similar) — never ends a measure, skip
        ElseIf IsBarTokenType(tokenType) Then
            If currentMeasureUnits >= (UnitsPerMeasure - tol) Then
                ' Full game-measure boundary — flush snippet
                snippetBodies(snippetCount) = Trim$(currentBody)
                snippetUnits(snippetCount) = currentMeasureUnits
                snippetCount = snippetCount + 1
                currentBody = ""
                currentMeasureUnits = 0#
            ElseIf currentMeasureUnits > EPSILON Then
                ' Partial at this ABC barline — look ahead to see if next fragment
                ' completes the game measure (split-bar join, e.g. A-tail + B-pickup).
                Dim segEnd As Long
                Dim nextUnits As Double
                segEnd = 0
                nextUnits = GetNextSegmentUnits(flatTokens, i + 1, segEnd)

                If MergeSplitBarsForScore And Abs((currentMeasureUnits + nextUnits) - UnitsPerMeasure) <= tol Then
                    ' Mid-game-measure ABC barline — drop it, keep accumulating
                    ' (the two partial bars form one game measure)
                Else
                    ' Genuine boundary — flush as partial measure (pickup, final, or cadence)
                    snippetBodies(snippetCount) = Trim$(currentBody)
                    snippetUnits(snippetCount) = currentMeasureUnits
                    snippetCount = snippetCount + 1
                    currentBody = ""
                    currentMeasureUnits = 0#
                End If
            End If
            ' Barlines terminate tuplet context for snippet-duration math.
            inTuplet = False
            tupletRatio = 1#
            tupletRemaining = 0
            ' else: zero units, barline between start_bar and first note — skip
        Else
            AppendRenderableToken currentBody, t
            Select Case tokenType
                Case "tuplet"
                    Dim tupletN As Long
                    tupletN = CLng(Mid$(CStr(t(2)), 2, 1))
                    inTuplet = True
                    tupletRemaining = tupletN
                    Select Case tupletN
                        Case 2
                            tupletRatio = 1.5
                        Case 3
                            tupletRatio = 0.666666667
                        Case 4
                            tupletRatio = 0.75
                        Case Else
                            tupletRatio = CDbl(tupletN - 1) / CDbl(tupletN)
                    End Select

                Case "tuplet_end"
                    inTuplet = False
                    tupletRatio = 1#
                    tupletRemaining = 0

                Case "note"
                    Dim noteUnits As Double
                    noteUnits = GetNoteDurationUnits(CStr(t(2)))
                    If inTuplet Then
                        noteUnits = noteUnits * tupletRatio
                        tupletRemaining = tupletRemaining - 1
                        If tupletRemaining <= 0 Then
                            inTuplet = False
                            tupletRatio = 1#
                        End If
                    End If
                    currentMeasureUnits = currentMeasureUnits + noteUnits
            End Select
        End If

        i = i + 1
    Loop

    ' Flush any remaining content as the final snippet
    If Len(Trim$(currentBody)) > 0 Then
        snippetBodies(snippetCount) = Trim$(currentBody)
        snippetUnits(snippetCount) = currentMeasureUnits
        snippetCount = snippetCount + 1
    End If

    If snippetCount = 0 Then
        BuildSnippetBundleJSON = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Serialise to JSON
    ' Each snippet is a complete standalone ABC: header lines + |body| wrapped in a standard bar.
    Dim tuneName As String
    tuneName = ""
    Dim hLines() As String
    hLines = Split(Replace(Replace(header, vbCrLf, vbLf), vbCr, vbLf), vbLf)
    Dim hi As Long
    For hi = LBound(hLines) To UBound(hLines)
        If Left$(Trim$(hLines(hi)), 2) = "T:" Then
            tuneName = Trim$(Mid$(Trim$(hLines(hi)), 3))
            Exit For
        End If
    Next hi

    ' Escape header for JSON embedding (newlines → \n, quotes escaped)
    Dim headerEsc As String
    headerEsc = EscapeJSON(header)
    ' Replace literal newlines with \n in the JSON string value
    headerEsc = Replace(headerEsc, vbCrLf, "\n")
    headerEsc = Replace(headerEsc, vbLf, "\n")
    headerEsc = Replace(headerEsc, vbCr, "\n")

    ' Determine if first snippet is a pickup
    Dim isFirstPickup As Boolean
    isFirstPickup = (snippetCount > 1) And (snippetUnits(0) < UnitsPerMeasure - tol)

    ' One image per playback measure (no deduplication).
    ' playback_to_image is identity so seq index maps directly to sprite index.
    Dim playbackToImage() As Long
    ReDim playbackToImage(0 To snippetCount - 1)

    Dim si As Long
    For si = 0 To snippetCount - 1
        playbackToImage(si) = si
    Next si

    Dim json As String
    json = "{" & vbCrLf
    json = json & "      ""tune"": """ & EscapeJSON(tuneName) & """," & vbCrLf
    If groupName <> "" Then
        json = json & "      ""group"": """ & EscapeJSON(groupName) & """," & vbCrLf
    End If
    json = json & "      ""header"": """ & headerEsc & """," & vbCrLf
    json = json & "      ""beats_per_measure"": " & CStr(BeatsPerMeasure) & "," & vbCrLf
    json = json & "      ""units_per_measure"": " & FormatJSONNumber(UnitsPerMeasure) & "," & vbCrLf
    json = json & "      ""has_pickup"": " & IIf(isFirstPickup, "true", "false") & "," & vbCrLf
    json = json & "      ""unit_note_fraction"": " & FormatJSONNumber(UnitNoteFraction) & "," & vbCrLf

    ' playback_to_image: maps each playback-order measure (0-based, repeat-expanded) to its
    ' physical image index in the snippets array. This is the authoritative lookup for the
    ' GML score lane — no more implicit seq→image guessing.
    json = json & "      ""playback_to_image"": ["
    Dim ptiFirst As Boolean
    ptiFirst = True
    For si = 0 To snippetCount - 1
        If Not ptiFirst Then json = json & ", "
        ptiFirst = False
        json = json & CStr(playbackToImage(si))
    Next si
    json = json & "]," & vbCrLf

    json = json & "      ""snippets"": [" & vbCrLf

    Dim firstSnippet As Boolean
    firstSnippet = True
    For si = 0 To snippetCount - 1
        If Not firstSnippet Then json = json & "," & vbCrLf
        firstSnippet = False

        Dim bodyEsc As String
        bodyEsc = EscapeJSON(snippetBodies(si))

        json = json & "        {" & vbCrLf
        json = json & "          ""measure_index"": " & CStr(si) & "," & vbCrLf
        If groupName <> "" Then
            json = json & "          ""group"": """ & EscapeJSON(groupName) & """," & vbCrLf
            json = json & "          ""group_index"": " & CStr(si) & "," & vbCrLf
        End If
        json = json & "          ""body"": """ & bodyEsc & """," & vbCrLf
        json = json & "          ""duration_units"": " & FormatJSONNumber(snippetUnits(si)) & "," & vbCrLf
        json = json & "          ""is_pickup"": " & IIf((si = 0) And isFirstPickup, "true", "false") & vbCrLf
        json = json & "        }"
    Next si

    json = json & vbCrLf & "      ]" & vbCrLf & "    }"

    BuildSnippetBundleJSON = json
End Function

Private Function AppendABCBodyLine(ByVal currentText As String, ByVal nextLine As String) As String
    currentText = Trim$(currentText)
    nextLine = Trim$(nextLine)
    If nextLine = "" Then
        AppendABCBodyLine = currentText
    ElseIf currentText = "" Then
        AppendABCBodyLine = nextLine
    Else
        AppendABCBodyLine = currentText & vbCrLf & nextLine
    End If
End Function

Private Function ResolveTransitionReferenceHeader(ws As Worksheet, ByVal refName As String, ByVal fallbackHeader As String) As String
    Dim refSheet As Worksheet
    Set refSheet = ResolveTransitionReferenceSheet(ws, refName)
    If refSheet Is Nothing Then
        ResolveTransitionReferenceHeader = fallbackHeader
    Else
        ResolveTransitionReferenceHeader = GetMetadataHeaderABC(refSheet)
        If Trim$(ResolveTransitionReferenceHeader) = "" Then ResolveTransitionReferenceHeader = fallbackHeader
    End If
End Function

Private Function ResolveTransitionReferenceSheet(ws As Worksheet, ByVal refName As String) As Worksheet
    Dim targetKey As String
    targetKey = LCase$(Trim$(refName))
    If targetKey = "" Then Exit Function

    Dim candidate As Worksheet
    For Each candidate In ws.Parent.Worksheets
        If LCase$(Trim$(candidate.Name)) = targetKey Then
            Set ResolveTransitionReferenceSheet = candidate
            Exit Function
        End If

        Dim candidateRef As String
        candidateRef = LCase$(Trim$(CStr(GetMetadataValue(candidate, "worksheet name"))))
        If candidateRef <> "" And candidateRef = targetKey Then
            Set ResolveTransitionReferenceSheet = candidate
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next candidate
End Function

Private Function GetMetadataHeaderABC(ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim r As Long
    For r = PART_TABLE_FIRST_ROW To PART_TABLE_MAX_ROW
        If LCase$(Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_TYPE_COL).Value)) = "metadata" Then
            GetMetadataHeaderABC = Trim$(ws.Cells(r, PART_TABLE_ABC_COL).Value)
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next r
    GetMetadataHeaderABC = ""
End Function

Private Function BuildExpandedABCForScore(ByVal fullABC As String) As String
    Dim header As String
    header = ExtractABCHeaderBlock(fullABC)

    CalculateRhythmicConstantsFromABCHeader header

    Dim bodyPrepared As String
    bodyPrepared = PrepareABCForVoice(fullABC, "")
    If Trim$(bodyPrepared) = "" Then
        BuildExpandedABCForScore = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim tokens As Collection
    Set tokens = TokenizeABC(bodyPrepared)

    Dim flatTokens As Collection
    Set flatTokens = ExpandRepeats(tokens)

    Dim expandedBody As String
    expandedBody = TokensToABCForScore(flatTokens)

    If Trim$(expandedBody) = "" Then
        BuildExpandedABCForScore = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    If Trim$(header) <> "" Then
        BuildExpandedABCForScore = header & vbCrLf & expandedBody
    Else
        BuildExpandedABCForScore = expandedBody
    End If
End Function

Private Function ExtractABCHeaderBlock(ByVal fullABC As String) As String
    Dim normalized As String
    normalized = Replace(fullABC, vbCrLf, vbLf)
    normalized = Replace(normalized, vbCr, vbLf)

    Dim lines() As String
    lines = Split(normalized, vbLf)

    Dim i As Long
    Dim outText As String
    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)
        Dim ln As String
        ln = Trim$(lines(i))
        If ln <> "" And IsMetadataHeaderLine(ln) Then
            If outText <> "" Then outText = outText & vbCrLf
            outText = outText & ln
        End If
    Next i

    ExtractABCHeaderBlock = outText
End Function

Private Function ExtractABCBodyBlock(ByVal fullABC As String) As String
    Dim normalized As String
    normalized = Replace(fullABC, vbCrLf, vbLf)
    normalized = Replace(normalized, vbCr, vbLf)

    Dim lines() As String
    lines = Split(normalized, vbLf)

    Dim i As Long
    Dim outText As String
    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)
        Dim ln As String
        ln = Trim$(lines(i))
        If ln <> "" And Not IsMetadataHeaderLine(ln) Then
            If outText <> "" Then outText = outText & vbCrLf
            outText = outText & ln
        End If
    Next i

    ExtractABCBodyBlock = outText
End Function

Private Sub CalculateRhythmicConstantsFromABCHeader(ByVal headerText As String)
    Dim meterText As String
    Dim unitLenText As String
    Dim normalized As String
    Dim lines() As String
    Dim i As Long

    normalized = Replace(headerText, vbCrLf, vbLf)
    normalized = Replace(normalized, vbCr, vbLf)
    lines = Split(normalized, vbLf)

    meterText = ""
    unitLenText = ""

    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)
        Dim ln As String
        ln = Trim$(lines(i))
        If Len(ln) >= 2 And Mid$(ln, 2, 1) = ":" Then
            Select Case UCase$(Left$(ln, 1))
                Case "M"
                    meterText = Trim$(Mid$(ln, 3))
                Case "L"
                    unitLenText = Trim$(Mid$(ln, 3))
            End Select
        End If
    Next i

    If meterText = "C" Then
        TimeSigNum = 4
        TimeSigDen = 4
    ElseIf meterText = "C|" Then
        TimeSigNum = 2
        TimeSigDen = 2
    ElseIf InStr(1, meterText, "/", vbBinaryCompare) > 0 Then
        Dim meterParts() As String
        meterParts = Split(meterText, "/")
        If UBound(meterParts) = 1 Then
            TimeSigNum = CLng(Trim$(meterParts(0)))
            TimeSigDen = CLng(Trim$(meterParts(1)))
        End If
    End If

    If TimeSigNum <= 0 Then TimeSigNum = 4
    If TimeSigDen <= 0 Then TimeSigDen = 4

    UnitNoteFraction = ParseFraction(unitLenText)
    If UnitNoteFraction <= 0 Then UnitNoteFraction = 0.125

    BeatsPerMeasure = TimeSigNum

    Dim beatFraction As Double
    beatFraction = 1# / CDbl(TimeSigDen)
    UnitsPerBeat = beatFraction / UnitNoteFraction
    UnitsPerMeasure = UnitsPerBeat * CDbl(BeatsPerMeasure)
End Sub

Private Function IsBarTokenType(ByVal tokenType As String) As Boolean
    Select Case tokenType
        Case "bar", "double_bar", "end_bar", "start_bar"
            IsBarTokenType = True
    End Select
End Function

Private Function TokensToABC(ByVal tokens As Collection) As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim outText As String
    For i = 1 To tokens.Count
        Dim t As Variant
        t = tokens(i)

        Select Case CStr(t(1))
            Case "note", "embellishment", "bar", "double_bar", "end_bar", "start_bar", "tuplet", "tuplet_end"
                ' Keep tokens contiguous so abcjs can form normal beams (eighth-note joins).
                ' Inserting spaces between every token forces visual beam breaks.
                outText = outText & CStr(t(2))
        End Select
    Next i

    TokensToABC = Trim$(outText)
End Function

Private Function TokensToABCForScore(ByVal tokens As Collection) As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim outText As String
    Dim currentMeasureUnits As Double
    Dim tol As Double
    Dim inTuplet As Boolean
    Dim tupletRatio As Double
    Dim tupletRemaining As Long

    ' Merge only truly complementary split bars (e.g., 7+1), not loose near-matches.
    tol = 0.02
    inTuplet = False
    tupletRatio = 1#
    tupletRemaining = 0

    i = 1
    Do While i <= tokens.Count
        Dim t As Variant
        Dim tokenType As String
        t = tokens(i)
        tokenType = CStr(t(1))

        If IsBarTokenType(tokenType) Then
            Dim segmentEndIndex As Long
            Dim nextSegmentUnits As Double
            segmentEndIndex = 0
            nextSegmentUnits = GetNextSegmentUnits(tokens, i + 1, segmentEndIndex)

            If MergeSplitBarsForScore And segmentEndIndex > i And segmentEndIndex <= tokens.Count Then
                If IsBarTokenType(CStr(tokens(segmentEndIndex)(1))) And _
                   currentMeasureUnits > EPSILON And _
                   currentMeasureUnits < (UnitsPerMeasure - EPSILON) And _
                   nextSegmentUnits > EPSILON And _
                   nextSegmentUnits < (UnitsPerMeasure - EPSILON) And _
                   Abs((currentMeasureUnits + nextSegmentUnits) - UnitsPerMeasure) <= tol Then

                    Dim j As Long
                    For j = i + 1 To segmentEndIndex - 1
                        AppendRenderableToken outText, tokens(j)
                    Next j

                    outText = outText & CStr(t(2))
                    currentMeasureUnits = 0#
                    ' Loop footer also increments i, so land on segmentEndIndex here.
                    ' This preserves the first token after the merged barline (e.g. {A}).
                    i = segmentEndIndex
                    GoTo NextScoreToken
                End If
            End If
        End If

        AppendRenderableToken outText, t

        Select Case tokenType
            Case "tuplet"
                Dim tupletN As Long
                tupletN = CLng(Mid$(CStr(t(2)), 2, 1))
                inTuplet = True
                tupletRemaining = tupletN
                Select Case tupletN
                    Case 2
                        tupletRatio = 1.5
                    Case 3
                        tupletRatio = 0.666666667
                    Case 4
                        tupletRatio = 0.75
                    Case Else
                        tupletRatio = CDbl(tupletN - 1) / CDbl(tupletN)
                End Select

            Case "tuplet_end"
                inTuplet = False
                tupletRatio = 1#
                tupletRemaining = 0

            Case "note"
                Dim noteUnits As Double
                noteUnits = GetNoteDurationUnits(CStr(t(2)))
                If inTuplet Then
                    noteUnits = noteUnits * tupletRatio
                    tupletRemaining = tupletRemaining - 1
                    If tupletRemaining <= 0 Then
                        inTuplet = False
                        tupletRatio = 1#
                    End If
                End If
                currentMeasureUnits = currentMeasureUnits + noteUnits

            Case "bar", "double_bar", "end_bar", "start_bar"
                currentMeasureUnits = 0#
                inTuplet = False
                tupletRatio = 1#
                tupletRemaining = 0
        End Select

NextScoreToken:
        i = i + 1
    Loop

    TokensToABCForScore = Trim$(outText)
End Function

Private Function GetNextSegmentUnits(ByVal tokens As Collection, ByVal startIndex As Long, ByRef segmentEndIndex As Long) As Double
    Dim inTuplet As Boolean
    Dim tupletRatio As Double
    Dim tupletRemaining As Long
    Dim i As Long

    inTuplet = False
    tupletRatio = 1#
    tupletRemaining = 0

    For i = startIndex To tokens.Count
        Dim t As Variant
        t = tokens(i)

        Select Case CStr(t(1))
            Case "tuplet"
                Dim tupletN As Long
                tupletN = CLng(Mid$(CStr(t(2)), 2, 1))
                inTuplet = True
                tupletRemaining = tupletN
                Select Case tupletN
                    Case 2
                        tupletRatio = 1.5
                    Case 3
                        tupletRatio = 0.666666667
                    Case 4
                        tupletRatio = 0.75
                    Case Else
                        tupletRatio = CDbl(tupletN - 1) / CDbl(tupletN)
                End Select

            Case "tuplet_end"
                inTuplet = False
                tupletRatio = 1#
                tupletRemaining = 0

            Case "note"
                Dim noteUnits As Double
                noteUnits = GetNoteDurationUnits(CStr(t(2)))
                If inTuplet Then
                    noteUnits = noteUnits * tupletRatio
                    tupletRemaining = tupletRemaining - 1
                    If tupletRemaining <= 0 Then
                        inTuplet = False
                        tupletRatio = 1#
                    End If
                End If
                GetNextSegmentUnits = GetNextSegmentUnits + noteUnits

            Case "bar", "double_bar", "end_bar", "start_bar"
                segmentEndIndex = i
                Exit Function
        End Select
    Next i

    segmentEndIndex = tokens.Count + 1
End Function

Private Sub AppendRenderableToken(ByRef outText As String, ByVal tokenValue As Variant)
    Select Case CStr(tokenValue(1))
        Case "note", "embellishment", "bar", "double_bar", "end_bar", "start_bar", "tuplet", "tuplet_end"
            outText = outText & CStr(tokenValue(2))
    End Select
End Sub

' INTERNAL: write JSON to a specific file path (used by ExportTuneAll)
' ============================================================
Private Sub ExportEventsToJSON_ToFile(ws As Worksheet, jsonFile As String)

    Dim json As String
    Dim metaTune As String, metaMet As String, metaPerf As String, metaInfo As String
    Dim rowIndex As Long

    metaTune = "": metaMet = "": metaPerf = "": metaInfo = ""

    For rowIndex = 2 To 48
        Dim category As String: category = Trim$(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 1).Value)
        Dim key As String:      key      = Trim$(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 2).Value)
        Dim val As String:      val      = Trim$(ws.Cells(rowIndex, 3).Value)
        If key <> "" Then
            Dim entry As String
            entry = """" & key & """: """ & EscapeJSON(val) & """"
            Select Case LCase$(category)
                Case "tune":        metaTune = metaTune & entry & ","
                Case "transition":  metaTune = metaTune & entry & ","
                Case "metronome":   metaMet  = metaMet  & entry & ","
                Case "performance": metaPerf = metaPerf & entry & ","
                Case "info":        metaInfo = metaInfo & entry & ","
            End Select
        End If
    Next rowIndex

    metaTune = TrimComma(metaTune)
    metaMet  = TrimComma(metaMet)
    metaPerf = TrimComma(metaPerf)
    metaInfo = TrimComma(metaInfo)

    Dim tuneCommaF As String
    tuneCommaF = IIf(metaTune <> "", ",", "")
    json = "{""tune"":{" & metaTune & tuneCommaF & _
           """has_pickup"":" & IIf(PickupDetected, "true", "false") & _
           ",""pickup_offset_units"":" & FormatJSONNumber(PickupOffsetUnits) & _
           ",""units_per_measure"":" & FormatJSONNumber(UnitsPerMeasure) & _
           ",""beats_per_measure"":" & CStr(BeatsPerMeasure) & _
           ",""measure_count"":" & CStr(DownbeatBarCount) & _
           "},""metronome"":{" & metaMet & "}," & _
           """performance"":{" & metaPerf & "},""info"":{" & metaInfo & "},""events"":["

    rowIndex = 51
    Do While ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EVENT_ID).Value <> ""
        Dim obj As String
        obj = "{""event_id"":" & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EVENT_ID).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""type"":"""       & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TYPE).Value)      & """"
        obj = obj & ",""structure"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_STRUCTURE).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""part"":"        & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_PART).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""voice"":"""     & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_VOICE).Value)     & """"
        obj = obj & ",""measure"":"     & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_MEASURE).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""beat"":"        & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_BEAT).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""division"":"    & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_DIVISION).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""phrase"":"""    & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_PHRASE).Value)    & """"
        obj = obj & ",""letter"":"""    & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_NOTE_LETTER).Value)   & """"
        obj = obj & ",""midi_value"":"  & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_NOTE_MIDI).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""written"":"     & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_WRITTEN_UNITS).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""adjusted"":"    & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_ADJUSTED_UNITS).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""total_units"":"  & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TOTAL_UNITS).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""emb_preceding"":""" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_PRECEDING).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""emb_literal"":"  & """" & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_LITERAL).Value)   & """"
        obj = obj & ",""emb_target"":"""    & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_TARGET).Value)    & """"
        obj = obj & ",""alt_anchor"":"""   & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_ALT_ANCHOR).Value) & """"
        obj = obj & ",""alt_timing"":"""  & NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_EMBELLISH_ALT_TIMING).Value)  & """"
        Dim brokenDir As String
        brokenDir = NzStr(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_BROKEN_DIR).Value)
        If LCase$(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TYPE).Value) = "note" And brokenDir <> "" Then
            obj = obj & ",""broken_dir"":""" & brokenDir & """"
        End If
        obj = obj & ",""start_time_ms"":"  & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_START_MS).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""end_time_ms"":"    & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_END_MS).Value)
        obj = obj & ",""tempo"":"          & NzNum(ws.Cells(rowIndex, COL_TEMPO_BPM).Value)
        obj = obj & "}"
        json = json & obj & ","
        rowIndex = rowIndex + 1
    Loop

    If Right$(json, 1) = "," Then json = Left$(json, Len(json) - 1)
    json = json & "]}"

    Dim ff As Integer
    ff = FreeFile
    Open jsonFile For Output As #ff
    Print #ff, json
    Close #ff

End Sub
